Question.en:
Given is a binary tree structure that contains values of type `a` in its nodes:

```haskell
data Tree a = Tip | Node (Tree a) a (Tree a)
```

The last value of a tree is the last value given by a left-to-right breadth-first traversal of the tree. A shoot is a list of all the values along the path from the root to some arbitrary tip in a tree. The last shoot of a tree is the shoot which ends at the last value of the tree. A tree is perfect when all its shoots have the same length. A tree is pruned by removing its last value. A tree is proper if it is the result of pruning a perfect tree zero or more times.

**[25]** **(a)**

**(i)** Define `perfect, proper :: Tree a -> Bool`, which each return `True` when a tree has that property and `False` otherwise (efficiency is irrelevant). You are given a function `height :: Tree a -> Int`.

**(ii)** Draw a proper binary tree with 10 nodes and a perfect binary tree with 15 nodes. Label the nodes with successive binary numbers starting from 1 at the root, such that the list resulting from a breadth-first traversal of each tree is in increasing order.

**(iii)** Write a (partial) function `prune :: Int -> Tree a -> (Tree a, a)`, such that `prune n t` takes a proper `t` of size `n` (these are pre-conditions) and returns a new tree with the last element (`x`) of `t` removed, along with `x` itself. It should run in $O(\log n)$. You are given a function `binary :: Int -> [Bool]`, which returns the binary representation of a number in $O(1)$.

**[25]** **(b)** The following type describes a heap, which contains a proper tree with the invariance that values along every shoot are ordered from smallest to largest:

```haskell
data Heap a = Heap (Tree a) Int
minimum :: Heap a -> a
insert :: Ord a => a -> Heap a -> Heap a
extract :: Ord a => Heap a -> Maybe (a, Heap a)
```

This representation stores the size of the tree, $M$, alongside it.

**(i)** Define the (partial) function `minimum`, which returns the smallest element in the heap in $O(1)$ time.

**(ii)** Define `insert`, such that `insert x h` will insert `x` into `h` (duplicates are allowed) in $O(\log M)$ time. You should push `x` towards the last value in `h`.

**(iii)** Define `extract`, which returns the minimum value from a heap and a new heap with that value removed in $O(\log M)$.

The two parts carry equal marks.
Question.zh-Hans:
给定在节点存类型 `a` 值的二叉树结构：

```haskell
data Tree a = Tip | Node (Tree a) a (Tree a)
```

树的末值是左到右广度优先遍历给出的最后一个值。shoot 是从根到树中某个 tip 的路径上全部值构成的列表。树的末 shoot 是以树末值收尾的 shoot。树完美当其所有 shoot 等长。树被剪枝即移除其末值。树 proper 当它是对完美树剪枝零次或多次的结果。

**[25 分]** **(a)**

**(i)** 定义 `perfect, proper :: Tree a -> Bool`：树具有相应性质时返回 `True`，否则 `False`（效率无关紧要）。给定函数 `height :: Tree a -> Int`。

**(ii)** 画一棵 10 节点的 proper 二叉树与一棵 15 节点的完美二叉树。节点从根起依次标以二进制数（从 1 开始），使每棵树广度优先遍历所得列表递增。

**(iii)** 写（部分）函数 `prune :: Int -> Tree a -> (Tree a, a)`：`prune n t` 取大小为 `n` 的 proper 树 `t`（前置条件），返回移除 `t` 的末元素 `x` 后的新树连同 `x` 本身。须 $O(\log n)$。给定函数 `binary :: Int -> [Bool]`（$O(1)$ 返回数的二进制表示）。

**[25 分]** **(b)** 下面的类型描述堆：含一棵 proper 树，并满足不变式——每条 shoot 上的值从小到大有序：

```haskell
data Heap a = Heap (Tree a) Int
minimum :: Heap a -> a
insert :: Ord a => a -> Heap a -> Heap a
extract :: Ord a => Heap a -> Maybe (a, Heap a)
```

该表示同时存放树的大小 $M$。

**(i)** 定义（部分）函数 `minimum`：$O(1)$ 返回堆中最小元素。

**(ii)** 定义 `insert`：`insert x h` 把 `x` 插入 `h`（允许重复），$O(\log M)$。应把 `x` 向 `h` 的末值方向推。

**(iii)** 定义 `extract`：$O(\log M)$ 返回堆的最小值与移除该值后的新堆。

两部分分值相同。
Question.zh-Hant:
給定在節點存類型 `a` 值的二叉樹結構：

```haskell
data Tree a = Tip | Node (Tree a) a (Tree a)
```

樹的末值是左到右廣度優先遍歷給出的最後一個值。shoot 是從根到樹中某個 tip 的路徑上全部值構成的列表。樹的末 shoot 是以樹末值收尾的 shoot。樹完美當其所有 shoot 等長。樹被剪枝即移除其末值。樹 proper 當它是對完美樹剪枝零次或多次的結果。

**[25 分]** **(a)**

**(i)** 定義 `perfect, proper :: Tree a -> Bool`：樹具有相應性質時返回 `True`，否則 `False`（效率無關緊要）。給定函數 `height :: Tree a -> Int`。

**(ii)** 畫一棵 10 節點的 proper 二叉樹與一棵 15 節點的完美二叉樹。節點從根起依次標以二進制數（從 1 開始），使每棵樹廣度優先遍歷所得列表遞增。

**(iii)** 寫（部分）函數 `prune :: Int -> Tree a -> (Tree a, a)`：`prune n t` 取大小爲 `n` 的 proper 樹 `t`（前置條件），返回移除 `t` 的末元素 `x` 後的新樹連同 `x` 本身。須 $O(\log n)$。給定函數 `binary :: Int -> [Bool]`（$O(1)$ 返回數的二進制表示）。

**[25 分]** **(b)** 下面的類型描述堆：含一棵 proper 樹，並滿足不變式——每條 shoot 上的值從小到大有序：

```haskell
data Heap a = Heap (Tree a) Int
minimum :: Heap a -> a
insert :: Ord a => a -> Heap a -> Heap a
extract :: Ord a => Heap a -> Maybe (a, Heap a)
```

該表示同時存放樹的大小 $M$。

**(i)** 定義（部分）函數 `minimum`：$O(1)$ 返回堆中最小元素。

**(ii)** 定義 `insert`：`insert x h` 把 `x` 插入 `h`（允許重複），$O(\log M)$。應把 `x` 向 `h` 的末值方向推。

**(iii)** 定義 `extract`：$O(\log M)$ 返回堆的最小值與移除該值後的新堆。

兩部分分值相同。

Markscheme.en:
**(a)(i)**

```haskell
perfect :: Tree a -> Bool
perfect Tip          = True
perfect (Node _ l r) = height l == height r
                    && perfect l && perfect r

proper :: Tree a -> Bool
proper Tip = True
proper (Node _ l r)
  | height r == height l - 1 = perfect l && proper r
  | height r == height l     = perfect l && perfect r
  | otherwise                = False
```

**(a)(ii)** Heap-shape numbering 1..k breadth-first; the binary label spells the path (drop the leading 1; 0 = left, 1 = right):

- perfect, 15 nodes: full four levels, labels 1..15.
- proper, 10 nodes: labels 1..10 — 1; 10, 11; 100, 101, 110, 111; 1000, 1001, 1010 (last level filled from the left).

**(a)(iii)** The last value of a proper tree of size n sits at the path spelled by `binary n` (drop the leading 1). Walk the path, capture the node's value, replace the node by `Tip`:

```haskell
prune :: Int -> Tree a -> (Tree a, a)
prune n t = go (tail (binary n)) t
  where
    go []       (Node _ Tip Tip) = (Tip, undefined)  -- value read on the way in; see below
    -- cleaner: thread the value out
    go (b:bs) (Node v l r)
      | not b    = let (l', x) = go bs l in (Node v l' r, x)
      | b       = let (r', x) = go bs r in (Node v l r', x)
    go [] (Node v Tip Tip) = (Tip, v)
```

The path has $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor$ bits; each step rebuilds one node: $O(\log n)$.

**(b)(i)** The shoot invariant makes the root the minimum:

```haskell
minimum (Heap (Node v _ _) _) = v
```

O(1) by pattern match.

**(b)(ii)** Insert at the last slot (path from `binary (M+1)`), then sift up along the shoot:

```haskell
insert :: Ord a => a -> Heap a -> Heap a
insert x (Heap t m) = (Heap (fix (tail (binary (m + 1))) t) (m + 1))
  where
    fix [] Tip            = Node x Tip Tip
    fix (b:bs) (Node v l r)
      | not b    = sift (Node v (fix bs l) r)
      | b       = sift (Node v l (fix bs r))
    sift (Node v l r)        -- swap x upward while smaller than its parent:
      = node (min v (rootish)) ... -- rebuild with min at each level
```

(Full version: on the way back up, at each node place `min v x` and carry the loser down — the usual sift-up.) Path length $\log_2(M+1)$: $O(\log M)$.

**(b)(iii)** prune the last slot, move its value to the root, sift down:

```haskell
extract :: Ord a => Heap a -> Maybe (a, Heap a)
extract (Heap _ 0)         = Nothing
extract (Heap t m)         = Just (root t, Heap (siftDown (setRoot t' last)) (m - 1))
  where
    root (Node v _ _)  = v
    (t', last)         = prune m t                -- O(log m)
    setRoot Tip y                 = Node y Tip Tip
    setRoot (Node _ l r) y         = Node y l r
    -- siftDown: while the node value exceeds a child's, swap with the smaller child
```

prune O(log M) + one root-to-leaf sift: $O(\log M)$.
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
**(a)(i)**

```haskell

perfect Tip          = True
perfect (Node _ l r) = height l == height r
                    && perfect l && perfect r

proper :: Tree a -> Bool
proper Tip = True
proper (Node _ l r)
  | height r == height l - 1 = perfect l && proper r

  | otherwise                = False
```

**(a)(ii)** 堆形状按广度优先编号 1..k；二进制标号拼出路径（去掉首位 1；0 = 左，1 = 右）：

- 完美 15 节点：四层全满，标号 1..15。
- proper 10 节点：标号 1..10——1; 10, 11; 100, 101, 110, 111; 1000, 1001, 1010（末层从左填）。

**(a)(iii)** 大小 n 的 proper 树的末值位于 `binary n` 拼出的路径（去掉首位 1）处。沿路径走、取该节点的值、把节点替换为 `Tip`：

```haskell
prune :: Int -> Tree a -> (Tree a, a)
prune n t = go (tail (binary n)) t
  where
    go (b:bs) (Node v l r)
      | not b    = let (l', x) = go bs l in (Node v l' r, x)
        | b       = let (r', x) = go bs r in (Node v l r', x)
    go [] (Node v Tip Tip) = (Tip, v)
```

路径有 $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor$ 位；每步重建一个节点：$O(\log n)$。

**(b)(i)** shoot 不变式使根即最小值：

```haskell
minimum (Heap (Node v _ _) _) = v
```

一次模式匹配，O(1)。

**(b)(ii)** 插到末位槽（路径来自 `binary (M+1)`），再沿 shoot 上滤：

```haskell
insert :: Ord a => a -> Heap a -> Heap a
insert x (Heap t m) = Heap (fix (tail (binary (m + 1))) t) (m + 1)
   where
    fix [] Tip            = Node x Tip Tip
    fix (b:bs) (Node v l r)
      | not b    = sift (Node v (fix bs l) r)
      | b       = sift (Node v l (fix bs r))
    -- sift：回溯途中若 x 小于父则交换（每层取 min 重建）
```

路径长 $\log_2(M+1)$：$O(\log M)$。

**(b)(iii)** 剪掉末位槽、把其值移到根、下滤：

```haskell
extract :: Ord a => Heap a -> Maybe (a, Heap a)
extract (Heap _ 0)         = Nothing
extract (Heap t m)         = Just (root t, Heap (siftDown (setRoot t' last)) (m - 1))
  where
    root (Node v _ _)  = v
    (t', last)         = prune m t                -- O(log m)
    setRoot Tip y                 = Node y Tip Tip
    setRoot (Node _ l r) y         = Node y l r
    -- siftDown：只要节点值大于某个孩子，就与较小的孩子交换
```

prune O(log M) 加一条根到叶的下滤：$O(\log M)$。

Question.en: (ADWH, p39, Exercise 2.3) Prove formally that $(n+1)^2 \in \Theta(n^2)$ by exhibiting the necessary constants.
Question.zh-Hans: （ADWH 第 39 页，习题 2.3）通过展示必要的常数，形式化证明 $(n+1)^2 \in \Theta(n^2)$。
Question.zh-Hant: （ADWH 第 39 頁，習題 2.3）通過展示必要的常數，形式化證明 $(n+1)^2 \in \Theta(n^2)$。

Markscheme.en:
From the course definitions:

$O(g) = \{f \mid \exists\delta>0.\exists n_0>0.\forall n>n_0.\ f(n) \le \delta g(n)\}$,  $\Omega(g)$ dually with $\ge$, and $\Theta(g) = O(g) \cap \Omega(g)$.

Here $f(n) = (n+1)^2 = n^2 + 2n + 1$ and $g(n) = n^2$.

**Upper bound.** Exhibit $\delta = 4$:

$(n+1)^2 \le 4n^2 \iff 0 \le 3n^2 - 2n - 1 = (3n+1)(n-1)$,

which holds for all $n \ge 1$; take $n_0 = 1$ (or any $n_0 \ge 1$).

**Lower bound.** Exhibit $\delta = 1$: $(n+1)^2 \ge n^2$ holds for all $n \ge 0$; take $n_0 = 0$.

Both witnesses with $n_0 = 1$: $(n+1)^2 \in O(n^2) \cap \Omega(n^2) = \Theta(n^2)$. ∎
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
按课程定义：

$O(g) = \{f \mid \exists\delta>0.\exists n_0>0.\forall n>n_0.\ f(n) \le \delta g(n)\}$，$\Omega(g)$ 对偶取 $\ge$，$\Theta(g) = O(g) \cap \Omega(g)$。

此处 $f(n) = (n+1)^2 = n^2 + 2n + 1$，$g(n) = n^2$。

**上界。** 取 $\delta = 4$：

$(n+1)^2 \le 4n^2 \iff 0 \le 3n^2 - 2n - 1 = (3n+1)(n-1)$，

对一切 $n \ge 1$ 成立；取 $n_0 = 1$（或任意 $n_0 \ge 1$）。

**下界。** 取 $\delta = 1$：$(n+1)^2 \ge n^2$ 对一切 $n \ge 0$ 成立；取 $n_0 = 0$。

两组见证合并（$n_0 = 1$）：$(n+1)^2 \in O(n^2) \cap \Omega(n^2) = \Theta(n^2)$。∎
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
按課程定義：

$O(g) = \{f \mid \exists\delta>0.\exists n_0>0.\forall n>n_0.\ f(n) \le \delta g(n)\}$，$\Omega(g)$ 對偶取 $\ge$，$\Theta(g) = O(g) \cap \Omega(g)$。

此處 $f(n) = (n+1)^2 = n^2 + 2n + 1$，$g(n) = n^2$。

**上界。** 取 $\delta = 4$：

$(n+1)^2 \le 4n^2 \iff 0 \le 3n^2 - 2n - 1 = (3n+1)(n-1)$，

對一切 $n \ge 1$ 成立；取 $n_0 = 1$（或任意 $n_0 \ge 1$）。

**下界。** 取 $\delta = 1$：$(n+1)^2 \ge n^2$ 對一切 $n \ge 0$ 成立；取 $n_0 = 0$。

兩組見證合併（$n_0 = 1$）：$(n+1)^2 \in O(n^2) \cap \Omega(n^2) = \Theta(n^2)$。∎

Question.en:
(ADWH, p39, Exercise 2.5) Justify whether each of the following is true or false:

1. $2n^2 + 3n \in \Theta(n^2)$
2. $2n^2 + 3n \in O(n^3)$
3. $n \log n \in O(n\sqrt{n})$
4. $\sqrt{n} + \sqrt[4]{n} \in O(\sqrt{n \log n})$
5. $2^{\log n} \in O(n)$
Question.zh-Hans:
（ADWH 第 39 页，习题 2.5）论证下列各命题的真假：

1. $2n^2 + 3n \in \Theta(n^2)$
2. $2n^2 + 3n \in O(n^3)$
3. $n \log n \in O(n\sqrt{n})$
4. $\sqrt{n} + \sqrt[4]{n} \in O(\sqrt{n \log n})$
5. $2^{\log n} \in O(n)$
Question.zh-Hant:
（ADWH 第 39 頁，習題 2.5）論證下列各命題的真假：

1. $2n^2 + 3n \in \Theta(n^2)$
2. $2n^2 + 3n \in O(n^3)$
3. $n \log n \in O(n\sqrt{n})$
4. $\sqrt{n} + \sqrt[4]{n} \in O(\sqrt{n \log n})$
5. $2^{\log n} \in O(n)$

Markscheme.en:
1. **True.** $2n^2 + 3n \le 5n^2$ for $n \ge 1$ (δ=5) and $\ge 2n^2$ (δ=2) — both bounds hold.
2. **True.** $2n^2 + 3n \le 5n^2 \le 5n^3$ for $n \ge 1$; Θ is not claimed, only O.
3. **True.** $n\log n \le n\sqrt n$ iff $\log n \le \sqrt n$, true from some $n_0$ (e.g. $n_0 = 16$: $4 \le 4$, and the gap widens).
4. **False.** Multiply both sides by $1/\sqrt{n}$: the claim becomes $1 + n^{-1/4} \in O(\sqrt{\log n})$. But $\sqrt{\log n} / 1 \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$ — the left side is at least 1 forever, the right side's ratio to $\sqrt n$ tends to 0, so no δ works. (Official answer: compare $\sqrt n \in O(\sqrt{\log n})$, i.e. $\sqrt{n/\log n}$ unbounded — false.)
5. **True.** $2^{\log_2 n} = n \in O(n)$ — equality itself (any log base only changes a constant factor).
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
1. **真。** $n \ge 1$ 时 $2n^2 + 3n \le 5n^2$（δ=5）且 $\ge 2n^2$（δ=2）——双界皆成立。
2. **真。** $n \ge 1$ 时 $2n^2 + 3n \le 5n^2 \le 5n^3$；只断言 O 而非 Θ。
3. **真。** $n\log n \le n\sqrt n$ 当且仅当 $\log n \le \sqrt n$，从某个 $n_0$ 起成立（如 $n_0 = 16$：$4 \le 4$，此后差距越拉越大）。
4. **假。** 两侧同乘 $1/\sqrt{n}$：命题化为 $1 + n^{-1/4} \in O(\sqrt{\log n})$。但左端恒 ≥ 1，而 $\sqrt{\log n}$ 与 $\sqrt n$ 之比趋于 0——任何 δ 都不成立。（官方答案：化为比较 $\sqrt n \in O(\sqrt{\log n})$，即 $\sqrt{n/\log n}$ 无界——假。）
5. **真。** $2^{\log_2 n} = n \in O(n)$——就是等式本身（对数底只差常数因子）。
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
1. **真。** $n \ge 1$ 時 $2n^2 + 3n \le 5n^2$（δ=5）且 $\ge 2n^2$（δ=2）——雙界皆成立。
2. **真。** $n \ge 1$ 時 $2n^2 + 3n \le 5n^2 \le 5n^3$；只斷言 O 而非 Θ。
3. **真。** $n\log n \le n\sqrt n$ 當且僅當 $\log n \le \sqrt n$，從某個 $n_0$ 起成立（如 $n_0 = 16$：$4 \le 4$，此後差距越拉越大）。
4. **假。** 兩側同乘 $1/\sqrt{n}$：命題化爲 $1 + n^{-1/4} \in O(\sqrt{\log n})$。但左端恆 ≥ 1，而 $\sqrt{\log n}$ 與 $\sqrt n$ 之比趨於 0——任何 δ 都不成立。（官方答案：化爲比較 $\sqrt n \in O(\sqrt{\log n})$，即 $\sqrt{n/\log n}$ 無界——假。）
5. **真。** $2^{\log_2 n} = n \in O(n)$——就是等式本身（對數底只差常數因子）。

paper_name.zh-Hant: 習題 1——漸近分析（第 2 周）

Question.en: Show formally that $o(g(n))$ is a **proper subset** of $O(g(n))$ for any function $g$, using their definitions.
Question.zh-Hans: 利用定义形式化证明：对任意函数 $g$，$o(g(n))$ 是 $O(g(n))$ 的**真子集**。
Question.zh-Hant: 利用定義形式化證明：對任意函數 $g$，$o(g(n))$ 是 $O(g(n))$ 的**真子集**。

Markscheme.en:
**Subset.** Let $f \in o(g)$. By definition, for *every* $\delta > 0$ there is $n_0$ with $f(n) < \delta g(n)$ for all $n > n_0$. Pick one witness, say $\delta = 1$: then $\exists\delta{=}1.\exists n_0.\forall n > n_0.\ f(n) \le 1 \cdot g(n)$ — exactly the definition of $f \in O(g)$. So $o(g) \subseteq O(g)$.

**Proper.** Take $f = g$. For $O$: with $\delta = 1$, $n_0 = 1$, $g(n) \le g(n)$ holds trivially, so $g \in O(g)$. But $g \notin o(g)$: suppose for every $\delta > 0$ eventually $g(n) < \delta g(n)$; choosing $\delta = 1$ gives $g(n) < g(n)$ — false. Formally, $\neg(\forall\delta.\exists n_0.\forall n > n_0.\ g(n) < \delta g(n))$ yields $\exists\delta{=}1.\forall n_0.\exists n > n_0.\ g(n) \ge g(n)$, which holds (any $n$). Hence $g \in O(g) \setminus o(g)$ and the inclusion is proper. ∎
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
**子集。** 设 $f \in o(g)$。由定义，对*每一个* $\delta > 0$ 存在 $n_0$ 使 $n > n_0$ 时 $f(n) < \delta g(n)$。只取一个见证，如 $\delta = 1$：即 $\exists\delta{=}1.\exists n_0.\forall n > n_0.\ f(n) \le 1 \cdot g(n)$——恰是 $f \in O(g)$ 的定义。故 $o(g) \subseteq O(g)$。

**真包含。** 取 $f = g$。对 O：$\delta = 1$、$n_0 = 1$ 时 $g(n) \le g(n)$ 平凡成立，故 $g \in O(g)$。但 $g \notin o(g)$：若对每个 $\delta > 0$ 终有 $g(n) < \delta g(n)$，取 $\delta = 1$ 得 $g(n) < g(n)$——假。形式化地，$\neg(\forall\delta.\exists n_0.\forall n > n_0.\ g(n) < \delta g(n))$ 给出 $\exists\delta{=}1.\forall n_0.\exists n > n_0.\ g(n) \ge g(n)$，对任意 $n$ 成立。故 $g \in O(g) \setminus o(g)$，包含为真包含。∎
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
**子集。** 設 $f \in o(g)$。由定義，對*每一個* $\delta > 0$ 存在 $n_0$ 使 $n > n_0$ 時 $f(n) < \delta g(n)$。只取一個見證，如 $\delta = 1$：即 $\exists\delta{=}1.\exists n_0.\forall n > n_0.\ f(n) \le 1 \cdot g(n)$——恰是 $f \in O(g)$ 的定義。故 $o(g) \subseteq O(g)$。

**真包含。** 取 $f = g$。對 O：$\delta = 1$、$n_0 = 1$ 時 $g(n) \le g(n)$ 平凡成立，故 $g \in O(g)$。但 $g \notin o(g)$：若對每個 $\delta > 0$ 終有 $g(n) < \delta g(n)$，取 $\delta = 1$ 得 $g(n) < g(n)$——假。形式化地，$\neg(\forall\delta.\exists n_0.\forall n > n_0.\ g(n) < \delta g(n))$ 給出 $\exists\delta{=}1.\forall n_0.\exists n > n_0.\ g(n) \ge g(n)$，對任意 $n$ 成立。故 $g \in O(g) \setminus o(g)$，包含爲真包含。∎

Question.en:
Calculate the asymptotic time complexity of `concatl xs` below in terms of $n$ and $m$, where `xs` contains $n$ lists, each containing $m$ elements:

```haskell
concatl :: [[a]] -> [a]
concatl = foldl (++) []
```
Question.zh-Hans:
以 $n$ 与 $m$ 计算 `concatl xs` 的渐近时间复杂度：`xs` 含 $n$ 个列表、每个含 $m$ 个元素：

```haskell
concatl :: [[a]] -> [a]
concatl = foldl (++) []
```
Question.zh-Hant:
以 $n$ 與 $m$ 計算 `concatl xs` 的漸近時間複雜度：`xs` 含 $n$ 個列表、每個含 $m$ 個元素：

```haskell
concatl :: [[a]] -> [a]
concatl = foldl (++) []
```

Markscheme.en:
Define a ternary recurrence $T(k, n, m)$ for `foldl (++) ys xss` where `ys` has $k$ elements and `xss` has $n$ lists of $m$ elements. Under *strict* evaluation the accumulated argument must be computed before the recursive call, and `(++)` is linear in its first argument:

$T(k, 0, m) = 1$

$T(k, n, m) = k + T(k + m,\ n - 1,\ m)$

Unrolling for `concatl` ($k$ starts at 0):

$T(0, n, m) = 0 + T(m, n{-}1, m) = 0 + m + T(2m, n{-}2, m) = \dots = \sum_{j=0}^{n-1} jm + T(nm, 0, m)$

$= m \cdot \frac{n(n-1)}{2} \in \Theta(n^2 m)$.

The quadratic factor in $n$ is the left-nested `(++)` — the whole prefix is re-traversed for every list appended. (Cf. the DList exercise: right-nested appends avoid this.)
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
为 `foldl (++) ys xss` 定义三元递推 $T(k, n, m)$：`ys` 有 $k$ 个元素、`xss` 有 $n$ 个长 $m$ 的列表。*严格*求值下，累积参数必须在递归调用前算好，而 `(++)` 对首参线性：

$T(k, 0, m) = 1$

$T(k, n, m) = k + T(k + m,\ n - 1,\ m)$

对 `concatl`（$k$ 从 0 起）展开：

$T(0, n, m) = 0 + T(m, n{-}1, m) = 0 + m + T(2m, n{-}2, m) = \dots = \sum_{j=0}^{n-1} jm + T(nm, 0, m)$

$= m \cdot \frac{n(n-1)}{2} \in \Theta(n^2 m)$。

$n$ 上的平方因子来自左嵌套的 `(++)`——每追加一个列表都要重走整个前缀。（对比 DList 习题：右嵌套的 append 可以避免这一点。）
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
爲 `foldl (++) ys xss` 定義三元遞推 $T(k, n, m)$：`ys` 有 $k$ 個元素、`xss` 有 $n$ 個長 $m$ 的列表。*嚴格*求值下，累積參數必須在遞歸調用前算好，而 `(++)` 對首參線性：

$T(k, 0, m) = 1$

$T(k, n, m) = k + T(k + m,\ n - 1,\ m)$

對 `concatl`（$k$ 從 0 起）展開：

$T(0, n, m) = 0 + T(m, n{-}1, m) = 0 + m + T(2m, n{-}2, m) = \dots = \sum_{j=0}^{n-1} jm + T(nm, 0, m)$

$= m \cdot \frac{n(n-1)}{2} \in \Theta(n^2 m)$。

$n$ 上的平方因子來自左嵌套的 `(++)`——每追加一個列表都要重走整個前綴。（對比 DList 習題：右嵌套的 append 可以避免這一點。）

en: foldl must evaluate the accumulated ++ before each recursive call — charge it.
After i lists, the accumulator has i*m elements; that is the cost of the next ++.
zh-Hans: foldl 每次递归前必须先算出累积的 ++——把代价记上。
追加 i 个列表后累积器有 i*m 个元素；这就是下一次 ++ 的代价。
zh-Hant: foldl 每次遞歸前必須先算出累積的 ++——把代價記上。
追加 i 個列表後累積器有 i*m 個元素；這就是下一次 ++ 的代價。

Question.en:
Implement an instance of `List` using the following `Tree` type:

```haskell
data Tree a = Tip | Leaf a | Fork (Tree a) (Tree a)
```

Ensure that the worst case complexity of `(++)` is O(1). What is the worst case complexity of `head`?
Question.zh-Hans:
用下面的 `Tree` 类型实现 `List` 的实例：

```haskell
data Tree a = Tip | Leaf a | Fork (Tree a) (Tree a)
```

保证 `(++)` 的最坏复杂度为 O(1)。`head` 的最坏复杂度是多少？
Question.zh-Hant:
用下面的 `Tree` 類型實現 `List` 的實例：

```haskell
data Tree a = Tip | Leaf a | Fork (Tree a) (Tree a)
```

保證 `(++)` 的最壞複雜度爲 O(1)。`head` 的最壞複雜度是多少？

Markscheme.en:
```haskell
instance List Tree where
  fromList []       = Tip
  fromList (x:xs)   = Fork (Leaf x) (fromList xs)
  toList Tip        = []
  toList (Leaf x)   = [x]
  toList (Fork l r)   = toList l ++ toList r
  xs ++ ys         = Fork xs ys
```

All other operations use their default implementations (through `fromList`/`toList`).

- `(++)` is one constructor application: **O(1)** worst case.
- `head xs = head (toList xs)`: `toList` walks the left spine, which can be a chain of `Fork`s of length $n$ before the first `Leaf` (e.g. `fromList` builds exactly that shape): **O(n)** worst case.
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
```haskell
instance List Tree where
  fromList []       = Tip
  fromList (x:xs)   = Fork (Leaf x) (fromList xs)
  toList Tip        = []
  toList (Leaf x)   = [x]
  toList (Fork l r)   = toList l ++ toList r
  xs ++ ys         = Fork xs ys
```

其余操作用默认实现（经 `fromList`/`toList`）。

- `(++)` 一次构造器应用：最坏 **O(1)**。
- `head xs = head (toList xs)`：`toList` 沿左脊柱走，最坏是长 $n$ 的 `Fork` 链后才见 `Leaf`（`fromList` 恰好构造这种形状）：最坏 **O(n)**。
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
```haskell
instance List Tree where
  fromList []       = Tip
  fromList (x:xs)   = Fork (Leaf x) (fromList xs)
  toList Tip        = []
  toList (Leaf x)   = [x]
  toList (Fork l r)   = toList l ++ toList r
  xs ++ ys         = Fork xs ys
```

其餘操作用默認實現（經 `fromList`/`toList`）。

- `(++)` 一次構造器應用：最壞 **O(1)**。
- `head xs = head (toList xs)`：`toList` 沿左脊柱走，最壞是長 $n$ 的 `Fork` 鏈後才見 `Leaf`（`fromList` 恰好構造這種形狀）：最壞 **O(n)**。

Question.en:
Define an instance of `List` using `DList` below, and give the complexities of all operations in terms of the length of the input list (assume all `DList` arguments to functions are built using the operations in `List`):

```haskell
newtype DList a = DList ([a] -> [a])
```

*Hint: `fromList xs = DList (xs++)`. Consider carefully whether the time complexity is affected by strict or lazy evaluation.*
Question.zh-Hans:
用下面的 `DList` 定义 `List` 的实例，并按输入列表长度给出全部操作的复杂度（假定传给函数的 `DList` 都由 `List` 的操作构建）：

```haskell
newtype DList a = DList ([a] -> [a])
```

*提示：`fromList xs = DList (xs++)`。仔细考虑严格求值与惰性求值是否影响时间复杂度。*
Question.zh-Hant:
用下面的 `DList` 定義 `List` 的實例，並按輸入列表長度給出全部操作的複雜度（假定傳給函數的 `DList` 都由 `List` 的操作構建）：

```haskell
newtype DList a = DList ([a] -> [a])
```

*提示：`fromList xs = DList (xs++)`。仔細考慮嚴格求值與惰性求值是否影響時間複雜度。*

Markscheme.en:
```haskell
instance List DList where
  toList (DList dxs)         = dxs []              -- O(n)
  fromList xs               = DList (xs++)           -- O(1)
  DList dxs ++ DList fys    = DList (dxs . fys)      -- O(1)
  empty                     = DList id               -- O(1)
  single x                  = DList (x:)             -- O(1)
  cons x (DList dxs)        = DList ((x:) . dxs)     -- O(1)
  snoc (DList dxs) x        = DList (dxs . (x:))     -- O(1)
  -- head/tail/init/last/isEmpty/isSingle/length/(!!): via toList, O(n)
```

**Key observation (lazy vs strict).** Any `DList f` built from these operations has $f = (y_0:) \circ (y_1:) \circ \dots \circ (y_m:)$ for some elements — because `(xs++)` equals that composition, and composition of compositions stays in the family. Under *lazy* evaluation, `toList (DList f) = f []` produces the first element in O(1) (peel one `(y:)`), so `head`, `tail`, `isEmpty`, `isSingle` are **O(1)** as well; under strict evaluation `toList` forces the whole chain: O(n).
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
```haskell
instance List DList where
  toList (DList dxs)         = dxs []              -- O(n)
  fromList xs               = DList (xs++)           -- O(1)
  DList dxs ++ DList fys    = DList (dxs . fys)      -- O(1)
  empty                     = DList id               -- O(1)
  single x                  = DList (x:)             -- O(1)
  cons x (DList dxs)        = DList ((x:) . dxs)     -- O(1)
  snoc (DList dxs) x        = DList (dxs . (x:))     -- O(1)
  -- head/tail/init/last/isEmpty/isSingle/length/(!!)：经 toList，O(n)
```

**关键观察（惰性 vs 严格）。** 由这些操作构建的任何 `DList f` 都有 $f = (y_0:) \circ (y_1:) \circ \dots \circ (y_m:)$——因为 `(xs++)` 等于该复合，复合的复合仍在族内。*惰性*求值下 `toList (DList f) = f []` 在 O(1) 内产出首元素（剥一层 `(y:)`），故 `head`、`tail`、`isEmpty`、`isSingle` 也是 **O(1)**；严格求值下 `toList` 强制整条链：O(n)。
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
```haskell
instance List DList where
  toList (DList dxs)         = dxs []              -- O(n)
  fromList xs               = DList (xs++)           -- O(1)
  DList dxs ++ DList fys    = DList (dxs . fys)      -- O(1)
  empty                     = DList id               -- O(1)
  single x                  = DList (x:)             -- O(1)
  cons x (DList dxs)        = DList ((x:) . dxs)     -- O(1)
  snoc (DList dxs) x        = DList (dxs . (x:))     -- O(1)
  -- head/tail/init/last/isEmpty/isSingle/length/(!!)：經 toList，O(n)
```

**關鍵觀察（惰性 vs 嚴格）。** 由這些操作構建的任何 `DList f` 都有 $f = (y_0:) \circ (y_1:) \circ \dots \circ (y_m:)$——因爲 `(xs++)` 等於該複合，複合的複合仍在族內。*惰性*求值下 `toList (DList f) = f []` 在 O(1) 內產出首元素（剝一層 `(y:)`），故 `head`、`tail`、`isEmpty`、`isSingle` 也是 **O(1)**；嚴格求值下 `toList` 強制整條鏈：O(n)。

Question.en:
Explain why the following implementation of `fromList` is undesirable:

```haskell
fromList xs = DList (++xs)
```

Then prove or disprove the following assertions for the `DList` instance of `List`:

1. `fromList (toList dxs) = dxs` for any `dxs :: DList a`.
2. `toList (fromList xs) = xs` for any `xs :: [a]`.
Question.zh-Hans:
解释为什么下面的 `fromList` 实现不可取：

```haskell
fromList xs = DList (++xs)
```

然后对 `DList` 的 `List` 实例证明或反驳下列断言：

1. 对任意 `dxs :: DList a`，`fromList (toList dxs) = dxs`。
2. 对任意 `xs :: [a]`，`toList (fromList xs) = xs`。
Question.zh-Hant:
解釋爲什麼下面的 `fromList` 實現不可取：

```haskell
fromList xs = DList (++xs)
```

然後對 `DList` 的 `List` 實例證明或反駁下列斷言：

1. 對任意 `dxs :: DList a`，`fromList (toList dxs) = dxs`。
2. 對任意 `xs :: [a]`，`toList (fromList xs) = xs`。

Markscheme.en:
**Why undesirable.** With this direction, appending builds *left-nested* `(++)` chains: `fromList xs1 ++ (fromList xs2 ++ (… ++ fromList xsn))` = `DList ((++xs1) . (++xs2) . … . (++xsn))`, and applying it to `[]` costs $\Theta(n^2 m)$ (Exercise 2.3) instead of $\Theta(nm)$ — the whole point of the representation is lost.

1. **Disprove.** Let `dxs = DList reverse`. Then

   `fromList (toList dxs) = fromList (reverse []) = fromList [] = DList ([]++)`

   which is the empty-list function, not `reverse` — different functions, so the assertion fails. (Observationally `DList` hides its internals, so two extensionally-equal functions may or may not be `==`; the counterexample shows the round trip does not preserve the *representation*.)
2. **Prove.** For any `xs :: [a]`:

   `toList (fromList xs) = toList (DList (xs++)) = xs ++ [] = xs`

   using `xs ++ [] = xs`. ∎
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
**为何不可取。** 这个方向使 append 积累*左嵌套*的 `(++)` 链：`fromList xs1 ++ (fromList xs2 ++ (… ++ fromList xsn))` = `DList ((++xs1) . (++xs2) . … . (++xsn))`，施加于 `[]` 的代价是 $\Theta(n^2 m)$（练习 2.3）而非 $\Theta(nm)$——表示的全部意义荡然无存。

1. **反驳。** 取 `dxs = DList reverse`。则

   `fromList (toList dxs) = fromList (reverse []) = fromList [] = DList ([]++)`

   这是空列表函数，不是 `reverse`——两个不同的函数，断言不成立。（`DList` 隐藏内部，外延相等的两个函数未必表示相同；反例说明往返并不保*表示*。）
2. **证明。** 对任意 `xs :: [a]`：

   `toList (fromList xs) = toList (DList (xs++)) = xs ++ [] = xs`

   用到 `xs ++ [] = xs`。∎
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
**爲何不可取。** 這個方向使 append 積累*左嵌套*的 `(++)` 鏈：`fromList xs1 ++ (fromList xs2 ++ (… ++ fromList xsn))` = `DList ((++xs1) . (++xs2) . … . (++xsn))`，施加於 `[]` 的代價是 $\Theta(n^2 m)$（練習 2.3）而非 $\Theta(nm)$——表示的全部意義蕩然無存。

1. **反駁。** 取 `dxs = DList reverse`。則

   `fromList (toList dxs) = fromList (reverse []) = fromList [] = DList ([]++)`

   這是空列表函數，不是 `reverse`——兩個不同的函數，斷言不成立。（`DList` 隱藏內部，外延相等的兩個函數未必表示相同；反例說明往返並不保*表示*。）
2. **證明。** 對任意 `xs :: [a]`：

   `toList (fromList xs) = toList (DList (xs++)) = xs ++ [] = xs`

   用到 `xs ++ [] = xs`。∎

Question.en:
Identify and prove that one of the base cases in the given definition of `qsort` is unnecessary:

```haskell
qsort :: [Int] -> [Int]
qsort []       = []
qsort [x]      = [x]
qsort (x:xs)   = qsort us ++ [x] ++ qsort vs
   where (us, vs) = partition (<= x) xs
```
Question.zh-Hans:
指出并证明上面 `qsort` 定义中哪个基例是不必要的：

```haskell
qsort :: [Int] -> [Int]
qsort []       = []
qsort [x]      = [x]
qsort (x:xs)   = qsort us ++ [x] ++ qsort vs
   where (us, vs) = partition (<= x) xs
```
Question.zh-Hant:
指出並證明上面 `qsort` 定義中哪個基例是不必要的：

```haskell
qsort :: [Int] -> [Int]
qsort []       = []
qsort [x]      = [x]
qsort (x:xs)   = qsort us ++ [x] ++ qsort vs
   where (us, vs) = partition (<= x) xs
```

Markscheme.en:
The `[x]` clause is unnecessary. Define `qsort'` without it and show `qsort' [x] = qsort [x]`:

```haskell
qsort' []      = []
qsort' (x:xs)  = qsort' us ++ [x] ++ qsort' vs
   where (us, vs) = partition (<= x) xs
```

Calculate:

```text
  qsort' [x]
=      {  (x:xs) clause, xs = []  }
  qsort' us ++ [x] ++ qsort' vs   where (us, vs) = partition (<= x) []
=      {  partition p [] = ([], [])  }
  qsort' [] ++ [x] ++ qsort' []
=      {  [] clause (both sides)  }
  [] ++ [x] ++ []
=      {  (++), identity on both sides  }
  [x]
=      {  qsort [x] clause  }
  qsort [x]
```

Since the remaining clauses are shared, `qsort' = qsort` on all inputs: the singleton clause adds no behaviour. ∎
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
不必要的基例是 `[x]`。定义去掉它的 `qsort'` 并证 `qsort' [x] = qsort [x]`：

```haskell
qsort' []      = []
qsort' (x:xs)  = qsort' us ++ [x] ++ qsort' vs
   where (us, vs) = partition (<= x) xs
```

计算：

```text
  qsort' [x]
=      {  (x:xs) 子句，xs = []  }
  qsort' us ++ [x] ++ qsort' vs   其中 (us, vs) = partition (<= x) []
=      {  partition p [] = ([], [])  }
  qsort' [] ++ [x] ++ qsort' []
=      {  [] 子句（两侧）  }
  [] ++ [x] ++ []
=      {  (++) 两侧单位元  }
  [x]
=      {  qsort [x] 子句  }
  qsort [x]
```

其余子句两者共享，故对一切输入 `qsort' = qsort`：单例子句不添任何行为。∎
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
不必要的基例是 `[x]`。定義去掉它的 `qsort'` 並證 `qsort' [x] = qsort [x]`：

```haskell
qsort' []      = []
qsort' (x:xs)  = qsort' us ++ [x] ++ qsort' vs
   where (us, vs) = partition (<= x) xs
```

計算：

```text
  qsort' [x]
=      {  (x:xs) 子句，xs = []  }
  qsort' us ++ [x] ++ qsort' vs   其中 (us, vs) = partition (<= x) []
=      {  partition p [] = ([], [])  }
  qsort' [] ++ [x] ++ qsort' []
=      {  [] 子句（兩側）  }
  [] ++ [x] ++ []
=      {  (++) 兩側單位元  }
  [x]
=      {  qsort [x] 子句  }
  qsort [x]
```

其餘子句兩者共享，故對一切輸入 `qsort' = qsort`：單例子句不添任何行爲。∎

Question.en: Recall that we defined `minimum = head . isort`. Calculate the (worst-case) running time of `minimum = head . qsort` (ADWH, p111, Exercise 5.5) and `minimum = head . msort`, in both strict and lazy contexts.
Question.zh-Hans: 回忆我们定义过 `minimum = head . isort`。分别在严格与惰性语境下计算 `minimum = head . qsort`（ADWH 第 111 页，习题 5.5）与 `minimum = head . msort` 的（最坏情形）运行时间。
Question.zh-Hant: 回憶我們定義過 `minimum = head . isort`。分別在嚴格與惰性語境下計算 `minimum = head . qsort`（ADWH 第 111 頁，習題 5.5）與 `minimum = head . msort` 的（最壞情形）運行時間。

Markscheme.en:
**Strict evaluation.** The whole sort runs before `head`: `head . qsort` is $O(n^2)$ (quicksort worst case) and `head . msort` is $O(n \log n)$ — laziness is the only thing that could save work.

**Lazy evaluation.**

- `head . qsort`: still **$O(n^2)$** worst case. Take a reverse-sorted input: the pivot is always the largest element, so `partition` splits into `[]` and $n-1$ elements, $n$ times, each partition linear — and no cons cell is produced until the spine of recursion bottoms out, so laziness cannot prune it. (On a *sorted* input, however, it is O(n): each partition returns the empty ``us`` immediately and the first `qsort vs` demand chain unrolls without materialising the right concatenations.)
- `head . msort`: **O(n)**. Since only the head is demanded, each `merge` call reduces to comparing two heads and returning one:

```haskell
  merge (x:_) (y:_) | x <= y    = [x]   -- head never looks at the tail
                   | otherwise = [y]
```

  so `foldt merge` degenerates to `foldt min`, which calls `min` $n-1$ times: linear. (`map single` and `head` are O(n)/O(1) and cannot dominate a linear function.)
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
**严格求值。** 整个排序先于 `head` 完成：`head . qsort` 为 $O(n^2)$（快排最坏情形），`head . msort` 为 $O(n \log n)$——能省功夫的只有惰性。

**惰性求值。**

- `head . qsort`：最坏仍是 **$O(n^2)$**。取逆序输入：枢轴恒为最大元素，`partition` 每次切成 `[]` 与 $n-1$ 个元素，共 $n$ 次、每次线性——且递归脊柱触底前不产生任何 cons 单元，惰性无从剪枝。（但*已排序*输入上是 O(n)：每次 `partition` 立即返回空 `us`，第一条 `qsort vs` 的需求链展开时不必物化右侧拼接。）
- `head . msort`：**O(n)**。只需要头，于是每次 `merge` 退化为比较两个头并返回其一：

```haskell
  merge (x:_) (y:_) | x <= y    = [x]   -- head 从不看尾
                   | otherwise = [y]
```

  故 `foldt merge` 退化为 `foldt min`，共调 $n-1$ 次 `min`：线性。（`map single` O(n)、`head` O(1)，不可能支配线性函数。）
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
**嚴格求值。** 整個排序先於 `head` 完成：`head . qsort` 爲 $O(n^2)$（快排最壞情形），`head . msort` 爲 $O(n \log n)$——能省功夫的只有惰性。

**惰性求值。**

- `head . qsort`：最壞仍是 **$O(n^2)$**。取逆序輸入：樞軸恆爲最大元素，`partition` 每次切成 `[]` 與 $n-1$ 個元素，共 $n$ 次、每次線性——且遞歸脊柱觸底前不產生任何 cons 單元，惰性無從剪枝。（但*已排序*輸入上是 O(n)：每次 `partition` 立即返回空 `us`，第一條 `qsort vs` 的需求鏈展開時不必物化右側拼接。）
- `head . msort`：**O(n)**。只需要頭，於是每次 `merge` 退化爲比較兩個頭並返回其一：

```haskell
  merge (x:_) (y:_) | x <= y    = [x]   -- head 從不看尾
                   | otherwise = [y]
```

  故 `foldt merge` 退化爲 `foldt min`，共調 $n-1$ 次 `min`：線性。（`map single` O(n)、`head` O(1)，不可能支配線性函數。）

Question.en:
Given a list of integers `xs` and some index `i` into `xs`, `splitDiff xs i` is the sum of all the integers up to `i` minus the sum of those from `i` onwards:

```haskell
splitDiff :: [Int] -> Int -> Int
splitDiff xs i = sum lhs - sum rhs
  where (lhs, rhs) = splitAt i xs
```

Write an algorithm which, given some `xs`, finds an `i` which maximises `splitDiff xs i`. Your algorithm should run in linear time. The following is a quadratic-time solution:

```haskell
maximise :: [Int] -> Int
maximise xs = maximumBy (comparing (splitDiff xs)) [0 .. length xs - 1]
```
Question.zh-Hans:
给定整数列表 `xs` 与下标 `i`，`splitDiff xs i` 是到 `i` 为止的整数之和减去从 `i` 起的整数之和：

```haskell
splitDiff :: [Int] -> Int -> Int
splitDiff xs i = sum lhs - sum rhs
  where (lhs, rhs) = splitAt i xs
```

写一个算法：给定 `xs`，找到使 `splitDiff xs i` 最大的 `i`。算法须线性时间。下面是二次方的解：

```haskell
maximise :: [Int] -> Int
maximise xs = maximumBy (comparing (splitDiff xs)) [0 .. length xs - 1]
```
Question.zh-Hant:
給定整數列表 `xs` 與下標 `i`，`splitDiff xs i` 是到 `i` 爲止的整數之和減去從 `i` 起的整數之和：

```haskell
splitDiff :: [Int] -> Int -> Int
splitDiff xs i = sum lhs - sum rhs
  where (lhs, rhs) = splitAt i xs
```

寫一個算法：給定 `xs`，找到使 `splitDiff xs i` 最大的 `i`。算法須線性時間。下面是二次方的解：

```haskell
maximise :: [Int] -> Int
maximise xs = maximumBy (comparing (splitDiff xs)) [0 .. length xs - 1]
```

Markscheme.en:
Memoise `splitDiff` itself: derive a recurrence on the index. Writing $x_j$ for `xs !! j`:

$$\text{sd}(i) = \text{sd}(i-1) + 2 x_{i-1}$$

with $\text{sd}(0) = -\sum xs$ (empty left part, whole right part). Then:

```haskell
maximise :: [Int] -> Int
maximise xs = maximumBy (comparing (table !)) [0 .. n - 1]
  where
    n      = length xs
    axs   = listArray (0, n - 1) xs
    table = tabulate (0, n - 1) memo
    memo 0 = -sum xs
    memo i = table ! (i - 1) + 2 * axs ! (i - 1)
```

Each entry is O(1) given the previous; $n+1$ entries: **O(n)**. (A slicker alternative, also linear: `maximise xs = fst (maximumBy (comparing snd) (zip [0..] sums))` where `sums = init (zipWith (-) (scanl (+) 0 xs) (scanr (+) 0 xs))` — prefix and suffix sums in one pass each.)
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
对 `splitDiff` 本身做记忆化：在指标上推递推。记 $x_j$ 为 `xs !! j`：

$$\text{sd}(i) = \text{sd}(i-1) + 2 x_{i-1}$$

其中 $\text{sd}(0) = -\sum xs$（左侧为空、右侧全量）。于是：

```haskell
maximise :: [Int] -> Int
maximise xs = maximumBy (comparing (table !)) [0 .. n - 1]
  where
    n      = length xs
    axs   = listArray (0, n - 1) xs
    table = tabulate (0, n - 1) memo
    memo 0 = -sum xs
    memo i = table ! (i - 1) + 2 * axs ! (i - 1)
```

每项由前项 O(1) 得出、共 $n+1$ 项：**O(n)**。（同样线性的更妙写法：`maximise xs = fst (maximumBy (comparing snd) (zip [0..] sums))`，其中 `sums = init (zipWith (-) (scanl (+) 0 xs) (scanr (+) 0 xs))`——前缀和与后缀和各一趟。）
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
對 `splitDiff` 本身做記憶化：在指標上推遞推。記 $x_j$ 爲 `xs !! j`：

$$\text{sd}(i) = \text{sd}(i-1) + 2 x_{i-1}$$

其中 $\text{sd}(0) = -\sum xs$（左側爲空、右側全量）。於是：

```haskell
maximise :: [Int] -> Int
maximise xs = maximumBy (comparing (table !)) [0 .. n - 1]
  where
    n      = length xs
    axs   = listArray (0, n - 1) xs
    table = tabulate (0, n - 1) memo
    memo 0 = -sum xs
    memo i = table ! (i - 1) + 2 * axs ! (i - 1)
```

每項由前項 O(1) 得出、共 $n+1$ 項：**O(n)**。（同樣線性的更妙寫法：`maximise xs = fst (maximumBy (comparing snd) (zip [0..] sums))`，其中 `sums = init (zipWith (-) (scanl (+) 0 xs) (scanr (+) 0 xs))`——前綴和與後綴和各一趟。）

Question.en:
Consider the following implementation of `fib` which uses the `fixer` helper function:

```haskell
fixer :: ((Int -> a) -> (Int -> a)) -> Int -> a
fixer f = f (fixer f)

fib :: Int -> Int
fib = fixer go
   where
       go r 0 = 0
       go r 1 = 1
       go r n = r (n - 1) + r (n - 2)
```

Reimplement `fixer` such that the resulting `fib` will be memoised.
Question.zh-Hans:
考察下面使用 `fixer` 辅助函数的 `fib` 实现：

```haskell
fixer :: ((Int -> a) -> (Int -> a)) -> Int -> a
fixer f = f (fixer f)

fib :: Int -> Int
fib = fixer go
   where
       go r 0 = 0
       go r 1 = 1
       go r n = r (n - 1) + r (n - 2)
```

重新实现 `fixer`，使得到的 `fib` 被记忆化。
Question.zh-Hant:
考察下面使用 `fixer` 輔助函數的 `fib` 實現：

```haskell
fixer :: ((Int -> a) -> (Int -> a)) -> Int -> a
fixer f = f (fixer f)

fib :: Int -> Int
fib = fixer go
   where
       go r 0 = 0
       go r 1 = 1
       go r n = r (n - 1) + r (n - 2)
```

重新實現 `fixer`，使得到的 `fib` 被記憶化。

Markscheme.en:
Route the recursive calls through a shared table:

```haskell
fixer :: ((Int -> a) -> (Int -> a)) -> Int -> a
fixer f n = table ! n
  where
    table = tabulate (0, n) (f memo)
    memo i = table ! i
```

`f memo` builds each row of the table from the *table itself*, so `r (n-1)` and `r (n-2)` inside `go` become O(1) lookups: `fib` becomes the standard tabulated DP, $\Theta(n)$.

A second solution uses an infinite lazily-computed list (fib's table only ever grows):

```haskell
fixer f = memo
  where
    table = map (f memo) [0 ..]
    memo i = table !! i
```

Trade-offs: the array version needs an upper bound (`n`) up front but lookups are O(1); the list version is unbounded and shares the table *between calls*, but `(!!)` is linear. (Best of both: a trie keyed by Int — log-time lookup, on-demand growth.)
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
让递归调用经过共享表：

```haskell
fixer :: ((Int -> a) -> (Int -> a)) -> Int -> a
fixer f n = table ! n
  where
    table = tabulate (0, n) (f memo)
    memo i = table ! i
```

`f memo` 从*表本身*构建每一项，`go` 内的 `r (n-1)`、`r (n-2)` 随之变成 O(1) 查表：`fib` 化为标准的表驱动 DP，$\Theta(n)$。

第二个解用无限惰性列表（fib 的表只会增长）：

```haskell
fixer f = memo
  where
    table = map (f memo) [0 ..]
    memo i = table !! i
```

取舍：数组版需要预先知道上界（`n`）但查表 O(1)；列表版无上界且表*跨调用*共享，但 `(!!)` 线性。（两全其美：以 Int 为键的 trie——对数查表、按需增长。）
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
讓遞歸調用經過共享表：

```haskell
fixer :: ((Int -> a) -> (Int -> a)) -> Int -> a
fixer f n = table ! n
  where
    table = tabulate (0, n) (f memo)
    memo i = table ! i
```

`f memo` 從*表本身*構建每一項，`go` 內的 `r (n-1)`、`r (n-2)` 隨之變成 O(1) 查表：`fib` 化爲標準的表驅動 DP，$\Theta(n)$。

第二個解用無限惰性列表（fib 的表只會增長）：

```haskell
fixer f = memo
  where
    table = map (f memo) [0 ..]
    memo i = table !! i
```

取捨：數組版需要預先知道上界（`n`）但查表 O(1)；列表版無上界且表*跨調用*共享，但 `(!!)` 線性。（兩全其美：以 Int 爲鍵的 trie——對數查表、按需增長。）

Question.en:
Supposing `xs0 :: Deque a` is the empty deque, show that the amortised complexity of each operation in the following sequence is O(1):

```text
xs0 ⇝ op0 xs1 ⇝ op1 xs2 ⇝ … ⇝ opn-1 xsn
```

where each `op_i ∈ {tail, snoc, cons}`.
Question.zh-Hans:
设 `xs0 :: Deque a` 是空 deque，证明下面序列中每个操作的摊还复杂度为 O(1)：

```text
xs0 ⇝ op0 xs1 ⇝ op1 xs2 ⇝ … ⇝ opn-1 xsn
```

其中每个 `op_i ∈ {tail, snoc, cons}`。
Question.zh-Hant:
設 `xs0 :: Deque a` 是空 deque，證明下面序列中每個操作的攤還複雜度爲 O(1)：

```text
xs0 ⇝ op0 xs1 ⇝ op1 xs2 ⇝ … ⇝ opn-1 xsn
```

其中每個 `op_i ∈ {tail, snoc, cons}`。

Markscheme.en:
Use the lecture's cost and potential functions:

- $C_{cons}(xs) = 1$,  $C_{snoc}(xs) = 1$,  $C_{tail}(\text{Deque}\ xs\ sy) = 1$ if $|xs| > 1$, else $|sy|$ (a reverse is forced);
- $\Phi(\text{Deque}\ xs\ sy) = \big||xs| - |sy|\big|$ — non-negative, $\Phi(xs_0) = 0$;
- amortised costs $A = 2$ for every operation.

Obligation: $C_{op}(xs) \le A + \Phi(xs) - \Phi(op\ xs)$.

- **cons/snoc** (symmetric): if the deque matches the first pattern (one side empty), $\Phi' - \Phi = \pm(|sy| - 1)$; using $|a - b| \le |a| + |b|$: $2 - \Phi' + \Phi \ge 2 - 1 - |sy| + |sy| = 1 = C$. Otherwise $\Phi' - \Phi = \pm 1$ and $2 - 1 = 1 = C$. ✓
- **tail**: the cheap patterns change $\Phi$ by at most 1, covered by $A = 2$. The expensive pattern ($xs = [x]$ singleton): $C = |sy|$ and the result is `fromList (reverse sy)` — a *balanced* deque with $\Phi' \approx 0$; so $\Phi - \Phi' \approx |sy| - 1$ and $A + \Phi - \Phi' \ge |sy| = C$ (the triangle inequality fills the slack, as in the lecture proof for `Deque xs ys`). ✓

Telescoping over the sequence: total cost $\le 2n + \Phi(xs_0) - \Phi(xs_n) \le 2n$: each operation is amortised O(1). ∎
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
用讲义的代价与势能函数：

- $C_{cons}(xs) = 1$、$C_{snoc}(xs) = 1$、$C_{tail}(\text{Deque}\ xs\ sy) = 1$（$|xs| > 1$ 时），否则 $|sy|$（被迫 reverse）；
- $\Phi(\text{Deque}\ xs\ sy) = \big||xs| - |sy|\big|$——非负，$\Phi(xs_0) = 0$；
- 每个操作的摊还代价 $A = 2$。

义务：$C_{op}(xs) \le A + \Phi(xs) - \Phi(op\ xs)$。

- **cons/snoc**（对称）：若命中一侧为空的模式，$\Phi' - \Phi = \pm(|sy| - 1)$；用 $|a - b| \le |a| + |b|$：$2 - \Phi' + \Phi \ge 2 - 1 - |sy| + |sy| = 1 = C$。否则 $\Phi' - \Phi = \pm 1$，$2 - 1 = 1 = C$。✓
- **tail**：便宜模式至多改变 $\Phi$ 1，$A = 2$ 覆盖。昂贵模式（$xs = [x]$ 单元素）：$C = |sy|$，结果是 `fromList (reverse sy)`——一个*平衡*的 deque，$\Phi' \approx 0$；于是 $\Phi - \Phi' \approx |sy| - 1$，$A + \Phi - \Phi' \ge |sy| = C$（三角不等式补足余量，与讲义对 `Deque xs ys` 的证明相同）。✓

对序列伸缩求和：总代价 $\le 2n + \Phi(xs_0) - \Phi(xs_n) \le 2n$：每个操作摊还 O(1)。∎
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
用講義的代價與勢能函數：

- $C_{cons}(xs) = 1$、$C_{snoc}(xs) = 1$、$C_{tail}(\text{Deque}\ xs\ sy) = 1$（$|xs| > 1$ 時），否則 $|sy|$（被迫 reverse）；
- $\Phi(\text{Deque}\ xs\ sy) = \big||xs| - |sy|\big|$——非負，$\Phi(xs_0) = 0$；
- 每個操作的攤還代價 $A = 2$。

義務：$C_{op}(xs) \le A + \Phi(xs) - \Phi(op\ xs)$。

- **cons/snoc**（對稱）：若命中一側爲空的模式，$\Phi' - \Phi = \pm(|sy| - 1)$；用 $|a - b| \le |a| + |b|$：$2 - \Phi' + \Phi \ge 2 - 1 - |sy| + |sy| = 1 = C$。否則 $\Phi' - \Phi = \pm 1$，$2 - 1 = 1 = C$。✓
- **tail**：便宜模式至多改變 $\Phi$ 1，$A = 2$ 覆蓋。昂貴模式（$xs = [x]$ 單元素）：$C = |sy|$，結果是 `fromList (reverse sy)`——一個*平衡*的 deque，$\Phi' \approx 0$；於是 $\Phi - \Phi' \approx |sy| - 1$，$A + \Phi - \Phi' \ge |sy| = C$（三角不等式補足餘量，與講義對 `Deque xs ys` 的證明相同）。✓

對序列伸縮求和：總代價 $\le 2n + \Phi(xs_0) - \Phi(xs_n) \le 2n$：每個操作攤還 O(1)。∎

en: The potential |len xs - len sy| is the stored imbalance; the expensive tail discharges it.
Verify the inequality per pattern of each operation — the singleton-xs case is the crux.
Use the triangle inequality to bound the potential jump in the empty-side patterns.

按每个操作的每个模式验证不等式——xs 为单元素的情形是关键。

Question.en:
Define `dec :: Binary -> Binary` that decrements a binary number discussed in the lecture, and show that the amortised complexity of repeated applications of `dec` is O(1). Determine if the amortised complexity of each operation in a sequence `op_i` where `0 <= i < n` and `op_i ∈ {inc, dec}` is still O(1).

```haskell
type Binary = [Digit]
data Digit = O | I

inc :: Binary -> Binary
inc []      = [I]
inc (O:bs)  = I:bs
inc (I:bs)  = O : (inc bs)
```
Question.zh-Hans:
定义讲义中讨论过的二进制数递减函数 `dec :: Binary -> Binary`，并证明反复施加 `dec` 的摊还复杂度为 O(1)。再判断：当序列 `op_i`（`0 <= i < n`）中 `op_i ∈ {inc, dec}` 混合时，每个操作的摊还复杂度是否仍为 O(1)。

```haskell
type Binary = [Digit]
data Digit = O | I

inc :: Binary -> Binary
inc []      = [I]
inc (O:bs)  = I:bs
inc (I:bs)  = O : (inc bs)
```
Question.zh-Hant:
定義講義中討論過的二進制數遞減函數 `dec :: Binary -> Binary`，並證明反覆施加 `dec` 的攤還複雜度爲 O(1)。再判斷：當序列 `op_i`（`0 <= i < n`）中 `op_i ∈ {inc, dec}` 混合時，每個操作的攤還複雜度是否仍爲 O(1)。

```haskell
type Binary = [Digit]
data Digit = O | I

inc :: Binary -> Binary
inc []      = [I]
inc (O:bs)  = I:bs
inc (I:bs)  = O : (inc bs)
```

Markscheme.en:
`dec` is symmetric to `inc`:

```haskell
dec :: Binary -> Binary
dec [I]     = []
dec (I:bs)   = O : bs
dec (O:bs)  = I : (dec bs)
```

**Repeated dec is amortised O(1).** Cost: $C_{dec}(bs) = t + 1$ where $t$ = number of leading `O`s; potential $\Phi(bs) = $ number of `O` digits; $A = 2$. After `dec bs = bs'`, the $t$ leading `O`s become `I`s and one `I` disappears: $\Phi' = \Phi - t + 1$… precisely, if $b$ = #`I`s and $b' = b - t + 1$:

$$C = t + 1 \le 2 + b - b' = 2 + t - 1 = t + 1 = A + \Phi - \Phi'. ✓$$

**Mixed {inc, dec} is NOT amortised O(1).** Take $bs = \underbrace{[I,I,\dots,I]}_n$ (the number $2^n - 1$) and the alternating sequence `inc, dec, inc, dec, …`. Every `inc` turns the leading `I` run into `O`s costing $\Theta(n)$, and the following `dec` turns them back — each operation costs $\Theta(n)$, so any constant $A$ fails over $n$ operations: amortised $\Theta(n)$ per operation. (Each operation alone is amortised O(1) against its own potential, but the two potentials count *different* digits — `I`s for inc, `O`s for dec — and each operation maximally inflates the other's bill.)
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
`dec` 与 `inc` 对称：

```haskell
dec :: Binary -> Binary
dec [I]     = []
dec (I:bs)   = O : bs
dec (O:bs)  = I : (dec bs)
```

**反复 dec 摊还 O(1)。** 代价：$C_{dec}(bs) = t + 1$（$t$ 为前导 `O` 的个数）；势能 $\Phi(bs) = $ `O` 位数；$A = 2$。`dec bs = bs'` 后，$t$ 个前导 `O` 变 `I`、一个 `I` 消失：设 $b$ 为 `I` 位数、$b' = b - t + 1$：

$$C = t + 1 \le 2 + b - b' = 2 + t - 1 = t + 1 = A + \Phi - \Phi'. ✓$$

**混合 {inc, dec} 摊还非 O(1)。** 取 $bs = \underbrace{[I,I,\dots,I]}_n$（数 $2^n - 1$）与交替序列 `inc, dec, inc, dec, …`。每个 `inc` 把前导 `I` 串变 `O`、代价 $\Theta(n)$，随后的 `dec` 又变回去——每个操作都花 $\Theta(n)$，任何常数 $A$ 在 $n$ 个操作上都不成立：每操作摊还 $\Theta(n)$。（单独看每个操作对自己的势能都是摊还 O(1)，但两个势能数的是*不同*的位——inc 数 `I`、dec 数 `O`——而每个操作都在最大程度抬高对方的账单。）
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
`dec` 與 `inc` 對稱：

```haskell
dec :: Binary -> Binary
dec [I]     = []
dec (I:bs)   = O : bs
dec (O:bs)  = I : (dec bs)
```

**反覆 dec 攤還 O(1)。** 代價：$C_{dec}(bs) = t + 1$（$t$ 爲前導 `O` 的個數）；勢能 $\Phi(bs) = $ `O` 位數；$A = 2$。`dec bs = bs'` 後，$t$ 個前導 `O` 變 `I`、一個 `I` 消失：設 $b$ 爲 `I` 位數、$b' = b - t + 1$：

$$C = t + 1 \le 2 + b - b' = 2 + t - 1 = t + 1 = A + \Phi - \Phi'. ✓$$

**混合 {inc, dec} 攤還非 O(1)。** 取 $bs = \underbrace{[I,I,\dots,I]}_n$（數 $2^n - 1$）與交替序列 `inc, dec, inc, dec, …`。每個 `inc` 把前導 `I` 串變 `O`、代價 $\Theta(n)$，隨後的 `dec` 又變回去——每個操作都花 $\Theta(n)$，任何常數 $A$ 在 $n$ 個操作上都不成立：每操作攤還 $\Theta(n)$。（單獨看每個操作對自己的勢能都是攤還 O(1)，但兩個勢能數的是*不同*的位——inc 數 `I`、dec 數 `O`——而每個操作都在最大程度抬高對方的賬單。）

Question.en:
Given is the data type `Tree` which is an instance of `List`. The tree `t :: Tree a` is **balanced** iff `t = Tip`, `t = Leaf a`, or `t = Node n l r` with balanced subtrees `l` and `r` such that `size l = size r`. Show that `(!!) :: Tree a -> Int -> a` takes $O(\log_2 n)$ time for balanced binary trees using a recurrence relation, where $n$ is the number of elements in the tree:

```haskell
data Tree a = Tip
            | Leaf a
            | Node Int (Tree a) a (Tree a)

size (Tip)      = 0
size (Leaf)    = 1
size (Node n _) = n
```
Question.zh-Hans:
给定作为 `List` 实例的数据类型 `Tree`。树 `t :: Tree a` **平衡**当 `t = Tip`、`t = Leaf a`，或 `t = Node n l r` 且子树 `l`、`r` 平衡并满足 `size l = size r`。用递推关系证明：对平衡二叉树，`(!!) :: Tree a -> Int -> a` 耗时 $O(\log_2 n)$（$n$ 为树中元素个数）：

```haskell
data Tree a = Tip
            | Leaf a
            | Node Int (Tree a) a (Tree a)

size (Tip)      = 0
size (Leaf)    = 1
size (Node n _) = n
```
Question.zh-Hant:
給定作爲 `List` 實例的數據類型 `Tree`。樹 `t :: Tree a` **平衡**當 `t = Tip`、`t = Leaf a`，或 `t = Node n l r` 且子樹 `l`、`r` 平衡並滿足 `size l = size r`。用遞推關係證明：對平衡二叉樹，`(!!) :: Tree a -> Int -> a` 耗時 $O(\log_2 n)$（$n$ 爲樹中元素個數）：

```haskell
data Tree a = Tip
            | Leaf a
            | Node Int (Tree a) a (Tree a)

size (Tip)      = 0
size (Leaf)    = 1
size (Node n _) = n
```

Markscheme.en:
Lookup compares the index against the left subtree's size and recurses into *one* subtree:

$$T(n) = \begin{cases} 1 & n \le 1 \\ 1 + T(n/2) & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}$$

Unrolling $k$ steps: $T(n) = k + T(n/2^k)$. The recursion bottoms out when $n/2^k \le 1$, i.e. $k \ge \log_2 n$; take $k = \lceil \log_2 n \rceil$:

$$T(n) = \lceil \log_2 n \rceil + 1 \in O(\log_2 n). ∎$$

(Balance is what makes the halving legitimate: `size l = size r` means whichever subtree the index selects holds exactly half the elements. The smart constructor `node lt x rt = Node (size lt + size rt + 1) lt x rt` keeps sizes correct for O(1) comparisons at each level.)
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
查找按下标与左子树 size 的比较、只递归进*一棵*子树：

$$T(n) = \begin{cases} 1 & n \le 1 \\ 1 + T(n/2) & \text{否则} \end{cases}$$

展开 $k$ 步：$T(n) = k + T(n/2^k)$。递归在 $n/2^k \le 1$ 即 $k \ge \log_2 n$ 时触底；取 $k = \lceil \log_2 n \rceil$：

$$T(n) = \lceil \log_2 n \rceil + 1 \in O(\log_2 n). ∎$$

（平衡正是减半合法的原因：`size l = size r` 保证下标选中的子树恰含一半元素。智能构造器 `node lt x rt = Node (size lt + size rt + 1) lt x rt` 维持 size 正确，使每层的比较 O(1)。）
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
查找按下標與左子樹 size 的比較、只遞歸進*一棵*子樹：

$$T(n) = \begin{cases} 1 & n \le 1 \\ 1 + T(n/2) & \text{否則} \end{cases}$$

展開 $k$ 步：$T(n) = k + T(n/2^k)$。遞歸在 $n/2^k \le 1$ 即 $k \ge \log_2 n$ 時觸底；取 $k = \lceil \log_2 n \rceil$：

$$T(n) = \lceil \log_2 n \rceil + 1 \in O(\log_2 n). ∎$$

（平衡正是減半合法的原因：`size l = size r` 保證下標選中的子樹恰含一半元素。智能構造器 `node lt x rt = Node (size lt + size rt + 1) lt x rt` 維持 size 正確，使每層的比較 O(1)。）

Balance means the chosen subtree holds exactly half the elements — write T(n) = 1 + T(n/2).
Unroll until n/2^k <= 1 and count the steps.

平衡意味着选中的子树恰含一半元素——写 T(n) = 1 + T(n/2)。
展开到 n/2^k <= 1，数步数。

平衡意味着選中的子樹恰含一半元素——寫 T(n) = 1 + T(n/2)。

Question.en:
Consider the definition of `RAList a`:

```haskell
newtype RAList a = RAList [Tree a]
```

1. Letting `head = (!!0)`, give the best-case and worst-case time complexities of `head xs` where `xs :: RAList a`.
2. Implement `tail :: RAList a -> RAList a` such that the amortised complexity of a sequence of `tail` is O(1).
3. Determine if the amortised complexity of a sequence of operations where each operation is either `tail` or `cons` is still O(1). *(Hint: compare with `inc` and `dec` for binary numbers.)*
Question.zh-Hans:
考察 `RAList a` 的定义：

```haskell
newtype RAList a = RAList [Tree a]
```

1. 取 `head = (!!0)`，给出 `head xs`（`xs :: RAList a`）的最好与最坏时间复杂度。
2. 实现 `tail :: RAList a -> RAList a`，使 `tail` 序列的摊还复杂度为 O(1)。
3. 判断每个操作为 `tail` 或 `cons` 的混合序列的摊还复杂度是否仍为 O(1)。*（提示：对比二进制数的 `inc` 与 `dec`。）*
Question.zh-Hant:
考察 `RAList a` 的定義：

```haskell
newtype RAList a = RAList [Tree a]
```

1. 取 `head = (!!0)`，給出 `head xs`（`xs :: RAList a`）的最好與最壞時間複雜度。
2. 實現 `tail :: RAList a -> RAList a`，使 `tail` 序列的攤還複雜度爲 O(1)。
3. 判斷每個操作爲 `tail` 或 `cons` 的混合序列的攤還複雜度是否仍爲 O(1)。*（提示：對比二進制數的 `inc` 與 `dec`。）*

Markscheme.en:
1. **Best case**: the first tree is a `Leaf` — O(1). **Worst case**: the list has $2^k$ elements so every tree in the list is `Tip` except the last (binary `100…0`): the walk skips $k-1$ empty trees and descends the last tree of size $2^{k-1}$: $O(\log n)$.

2. `tail` corresponds to `dec` on binary numbers — split the first non-`Tip` tree:

```haskell
tail :: RAList a -> RAList a
tail = snd . split
  where
    split :: RAList a -> (Tree a, RAList a)
    split (RAList [t])       = (t, RAList [])
    split (RAList (Tip : ts)) = let (Node _ l r, RAList ts') = split (RAList ts)
                          in (l, RAList (r : ts'))
    split (RAList (t : ts))  = (t, RAList (Tip : ts))
```

  (Analogue of borrowing in binary subtraction; with `Φ` = number of `Tip`s — the `O`s of the binary representation — each `tail` is amortised O(1), exactly as `dec` in Exercise 4.5.)

3. **No.** Mixed `cons`/`tail` mirrors mixed `inc`/`dec`: starting from a list of $2^k - 1$ elements (binary `111…1`, all trees present, no `Tip`s), the sequence `cons a, tail, cons a, tail, …` repeatedly merges all trees (cons) and splits them again (tail): each operation costs $\Theta(\log n) = \Theta(\log(\text{length } xs))$, so amortised O(1) fails for the same reason as Exercise 4.5's alternating sequence.
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
1. **最好情形**：首树是 `Leaf`——O(1)。**最坏情形**：列表有 $2^k$ 个元素，除末树外全是 `Tip`（二进制 `100…0`）：跳过 $k-1$ 棵空树再下降大小 $2^{k-1}$ 的末树：$O(\log n)$。

2. `tail` 对应二进制数的 `dec`——拆开第一棵非 `Tip` 树：

```haskell
tail :: RAList a -> RAList a
tail = snd . split
  where
    split :: RAList a -> (Tree a, RAList a)
    split (RAList [t])       = (t, RAList [])
    split (RAList (Tip : ts)) = let (Node _ l r, RAList ts') = split (RAList ts)
                          in (l, RAList (r : ts'))
    split (RAList (t : ts))  = (t, RAList (Tip : ts))
```

  （二进制减法借位的类似物；取 `Φ` = `Tip` 数——二进制表示的 `O` 位——则每个 `tail` 摊还 O(1)，与练习 4.5 的 `dec` 完全同理。）

3. **不再 O(1)。** 混合 `cons`/`tail` 镜像混合 `inc`/`dec`：从 $2^k - 1$ 个元素（二进制 `111…1`，所有树在场、无 `Tip`）出发，序列 `cons a, tail, cons a, tail, …` 反复合并全部树（cons）再全部拆开（tail）：每个操作代价 $\Theta(\log n) = \Theta(\log(\text{length } xs))$，与练习 4.5 的交替序列同理，摊还 O(1) 失效。
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
1. **最好情形**：首樹是 `Leaf`——O(1)。**最壞情形**：列表有 $2^k$ 個元素，除末樹外全是 `Tip`（二進制 `100…0`）：跳過 $k-1$ 棵空樹再下降大小 $2^{k-1}$ 的末樹：$O(\log n)$。

2. `tail` 對應二進制數的 `dec`——拆開第一棵非 `Tip` 樹：

```haskell
tail :: RAList a -> RAList a
tail = snd . split
  where
    split :: RAList a -> (Tree a, RAList a)
    split (RAList [t])       = (t, RAList [])
    split (RAList (Tip : ts)) = let (Node _ l r, RAList ts') = split (RAList ts)
                          in (l, RAList (r : ts'))
    split (RAList (t : ts))  = (t, RAList (Tip : ts))
```

  （二進制減法借位的類似物；取 `Φ` = `Tip` 數——二進制表示的 `O` 位——則每個 `tail` 攤還 O(1)，與練習 4.5 的 `dec` 完全同理。）

3. **不再 O(1)。** 混合 `cons`/`tail` 鏡像混合 `inc`/`dec`：從 $2^k - 1$ 個元素（二進制 `111…1`，所有樹在場、無 `Tip`）出發，序列 `cons a, tail, cons a, tail, …` 反覆合併全部樹（cons）再全部拆開（tail）：每個操作代價 $\Theta(\log n) = \Theta(\log(\text{length } xs))$，與練習 4.5 的交替序列同理，攤還 O(1) 失效。

Question.en:
Write a function `fromOrdList :: [a] -> HTree a` which builds an AVL tree from a sorted list in worst case linear time:

```haskell
data HTree a = HTip
                | HNode Int (HTree a) a (HTree a)   -- Int = height

fromOrdList :: [a] -> HTree a
fromOrdList xs = fst (go (length xs) xs)
   where
      go :: Int -> [a] -> (HTree a, [a])
      go = ...
```
Question.zh-Hans:
写函数 `fromOrdList :: [a] -> HTree a`：最坏线性时间内由有序列表建 AVL 树：

```haskell
data HTree a = HTip
                | HNode Int (HTree a) a (HTree a)   -- Int = height

fromOrdList :: [a] -> HTree a
fromOrdList xs = fst (go (length xs) xs)
   where
      go :: Int -> [a] -> (HTree a, [a])
      go = ...
```
Question.zh-Hant:
寫函數 `fromOrdList :: [a] -> HTree a`：最壞線性時間內由有序列表建 AVL 樹：

```haskell
data HTree a = HTip
                | HNode Int (HTree a) a (HTree a)   -- Int = height

fromOrdList :: [a] -> HTree a
fromOrdList xs = fst (go (length xs) xs)
   where
      go :: Int -> [a] -> (HTree a, [a])
      go = ...
```

Markscheme.en:
Split the sorted list at the midpoint recursively — the midpoint becomes the root, and the leftover list is threaded through:

```haskell
fromOrdList :: [a] -> HTree a
fromOrdList xs = fst (go (length xs) xs)
  where
    go :: Int -> [a] -> (HTree a, [a])
    go 0 xs  = (HTip, xs)
    go n xs1 =
      let m               = n `div` 2
         (lhs, x : xs2)  = go m xs1
         (rhs, xs3)       = go (n - m - 1) xs2
     in (HNode (1 + max (height lhs) (height rhs)) lhs x rhs, xs3)
    height HTip          = 0
    height (HNode h _ _ _) = h
```

Each element is consumed exactly once (O(1) work per element), so the whole build is **O(n)**. The result is AVL-valid by construction: the two halves differ in size by at most one, so their heights differ by at most one. (A continuation-passing variant — passing `k :: HTree a -> [a] -> b` instead of returning the leftover — avoids the tuple plumbing.)
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
递归从中点切分有序列表——中点做根，剩余列表穿针传递：

```haskell
fromOrdList :: [a] -> HTree a
fromOrdList xs = fst (go (length xs) xs)
  where
    go :: Int -> [a] -> (HTree a, [a])
    go 0 xs  = (HTip, xs)
    go n xs1 =
      let m               = n `div` 2
         (lhs, x : xs2)  = go m xs1
         (rhs, xs3)       = go (n - m - 1) xs2
     in (HNode (1 + max (height lhs) (height rhs)) lhs x rhs, xs3)
    height HTip          = 0
    height (HNode h _ _ _) = h
```

每个元素恰消费一次（每元素 O(1)），总建造 **O(n)**。构造即保证 AVL 合法：两半大小至多差一，故高度至多差一。（传续体变体——传 `k :: HTree a -> [a] -> b` 代替返回剩余——可免去元组管线。）
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
遞歸從中點切分有序列表——中點做根，剩餘列表穿針傳遞：

```haskell
fromOrdList :: [a] -> HTree a
fromOrdList xs = fst (go (length xs) xs)
  where
    go :: Int -> [a] -> (HTree a, [a])
    go 0 xs  = (HTip, xs)
    go n xs1 =
      let m               = n `div` 2
         (lhs, x : xs2)  = go m xs1
         (rhs, xs3)       = go (n - m - 1) xs2
     in (HNode (1 + max (height lhs) (height rhs)) lhs x rhs, xs3)
    height HTip          = 0
    height (HNode h _ _ _) = h
```

每個元素恰消費一次（每元素 O(1)），總建造 **O(n)**。構造即保證 AVL 合法：兩半大小至多差一，故高度至多差一。（傳續體變體——傳 `k :: HTree a -> [a] -> b` 代替返回剩餘——可免去元組管線。）

en: The middle element of the sorted list must be the root.
go returns the built tree AND the unconsumed tail so the right half starts where the left half stopped.
Sizes n div 2 and n - n div 2 - 1 differ by at most one — that is the AVL invariant for free.
zh-Hans: 有序列表的正中元素必须是根。
go 返回建好的树与未消费的尾部，使右半从左半停下的地方开始。
两半大小 n div 2 与 n − n div 2 − 1 至多差一——这就是白送的 AVL 不变式。
zh-Hant: 有序列表的正中元素必須是根。
go 返回建好的樹與未消費的尾部，使右半從左半停下的地方開始。
兩半大小 n div 2 與 n − n div 2 − 1 至多差一——這就是白送的 AVL 不變式。

Question.en:
There is a monoid instance on pairs of lists. Define a monoid instance for `Ordering` such that `uncurry compare` on pairs of lists of the same length is a monoid homomorphism.

```haskell
instance Monoid ([a], [a]) where
  eps                    = ([], [])
  (xl, xr) ⋄ (yl, yr) = (xl ++ yl, xr ++ yr)

compare :: Ord a => a -> a -> Ordering
-- returns LT, EQ or GT as x < y, x == y, or x > y
```
Question.zh-Hans:
列表对上有 monoid 实例。请为 `Ordering` 定义 monoid 实例，使等长列表对上的 `uncurry compare` 成为 monoid 同态：

```haskell
instance Monoid ([a], [a]) where
  eps                    = ([], [])
  (xl, xr) ⋄ (yl, yr) = (xl ++ yl, xr ++ yr)

compare :: Ord a => a -> a -> Ordering
-- 当 x < y、x == y 或 x > y 时分别返回 LT、EQ 或 GT
```
Question.zh-Hant:
列表對上有 monoid 實例。請爲 `Ordering` 定義 monoid 實例，使等長列表對上的 `uncurry compare` 成爲 monoid 同態：

```haskell
instance Monoid ([a], [a]) where
  eps                    = ([], [])
  (xl, xr) ⋄ (yl, yr) = (xl ++ yl, xr ++ yr)

compare :: Ord a => a -> a -> Ordering
-- 當 x < y、x == y 或 x > y 時分別返回 LT、EQ 或 GT
```

Markscheme.en:
The monoid for lexicographic comparison:

```haskell
instance Monoid Ordering where
  eps      = EQ
  EQ ⋄ y  = y      -- equal so far: the next verdict wins
  x  ⋄ _  = x      -- already decided: keep the verdict
```

With `h (xl, xr) = compare xl xr` on equal-length pairs: the first mismatch decides, exactly as `⋄` above; if all pairs match, both sides give `EQ = eps`. Formally:

- $h\ \epsilon = compare\ []\ [] = EQ = \epsilon$
- $h\ (p ⋄ q) = h\ p ⋄ h\ q$: appending matches on both sides — the comparison of the concatenation is the first non-EQ verdict of the parts (lengths being equal, position-wise pairing is preserved).
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
字典序比较的 monoid：

```haskell
instance Monoid Ordering where
  eps      = EQ
  EQ ⋄ y  = y      -- 迄今相等：以下一个判定为准
  x  ⋄ _  = x      -- 已有结论：保持判定
```

取等长对上的 `h (xl, xr) = compare xl xr`：第一个失配处定胜负，恰如上面的 `⋄`；若全部匹配，两边都给出 `EQ = eps`。形式化：

- $h\ \epsilon = compare\ []\ [] = EQ = \epsilon$
- $h\ (p ⋄ q) = h\ p ⋄ h\ q$：两侧同时追加——拼接后的比较结果是各部分第一个非 EQ 判定（等长保证逐位配对不乱）。
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
字典序比較的 monoid：

```haskell
instance Monoid Ordering where
  eps      = EQ
  EQ ⋄ y  = y      -- 迄今相等：以下一個判定爲準
  x  ⋄ _  = x      -- 已有結論：保持判定
```

取等長對上的 `h (xl, xr) = compare xl xr`：第一個失配處定勝負，恰如上面的 `⋄`；若全部匹配，兩邊都給出 `EQ = eps`。形式化：

- $h\ \epsilon = compare\ []\ [] = EQ = \epsilon$
- $h\ (p ⋄ q) = h\ p ⋄ h\ q$：兩側同時追加——拼接後的比較結果是各部分第一個非 EQ 判定（等長保證逐位配對不亂）。

Question.en:
Consider a data type representing a set, implemented using AVL trees. The trees will contain no duplicates. Write an `Eq` instance for this type. `(==)` should be linear, and should not differentiate between trees which are balanced differently:

```text
    2           4
   / \         / \
  1   4   ==  2   5
     / \     / \
    3   5   1   3
```

Given sets `xs` and `ys`, `f` is defined to be **well behaved** if it obeys:

$xs \equiv ys \Rightarrow f\ xs \equiv f\ ys$

Discuss whether the functions `member x` or `insert x` are well behaved. Give other examples of well behaved and non-well-behaved functions.
Question.zh-Hans:
考察用 AVL 树实现的集合类型。树中不含重复元素。为该类型写 `Eq` 实例。`(==)` 须为线性，且不区分平衡方式不同的树：

```text
    2           4
   / \         / \
  1   4   ==  2   5
     / \     / \
    3   5   1   3
```

给定集合 `xs` 与 `ys`，`f` **良行为**（well behaved）当它满足：

$xs \equiv ys \Rightarrow f\ xs \equiv f\ ys$

讨论 `member x` 与 `insert x` 是否良行为，并另举良行为与非良行为函数的例子。
Question.zh-Hant:
考察用 AVL 樹實現的集合類型。樹中不含重複元素。爲該類型寫 `Eq` 實例。`(==)` 須爲線性，且不區分平衡方式不同的樹：

```text
    2           4
   / \         / \
  1   4   ==  2   5
     / \     / \
    3   5   1   3
```

給定集合 `xs` 與 `ys`，`f` **良行爲**（well behaved）當它滿足：

$xs \equiv ys \Rightarrow f\ xs \equiv f\ ys$

討論 `member x` 與 `insert x` 是否良行爲，並另舉良行爲與非良行爲函數的例子。

Markscheme.en:
**Eq instance.** Compare the *in-order traversals* (which forget the shape):

```haskell
hTreeToList :: HTree a -> [a]
hTreeToList rt = go rt []
  where
    go HTip ks             = ks
    go (HNode _ lt p gt) ks = go lt (p : go gt ks)

instance Eq a => Eq (HTree a) where
  xs == ys = hTreeToList xs == hTreeToList ys
```

Both traversals are linear and (on distinct elements) sorted, so list equality decides set equality: **O(n)** (in fact O(min) with a lazy merge-style comparison).

**Well-behaved discussion.**

- `member x` **is** well behaved: it inspects only the *set* of elements (its result depends on membership, not shape) — $xs \equiv ys$ implies the same search verdict.
- `insert x` **is** well behaved: inserting into equal sets yields equal sets (possibly differently balanced, but `==` ignores shape).
- Well behaved also: `hTreeToList` (by construction), `size`, `toList . sort`-style functions — anything that factors through the set of elements.
- **Not** well behaved: `getRoot :: HTree a -> Maybe a` (returns the root value) — the two trees above are equal as sets but have roots 2 and 4; likewise `height`, or any function exposing shape.
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
**Eq 实例。** 比较*中序遍历*（它忘掉形状）：

```haskell
hTreeToList :: HTree a -> [a]
hTreeToList rt = go rt []
  where
    go HTip ks             = ks
    go (HNode _ lt p gt) ks = go lt (p : go gt ks)

instance Eq a => Eq (HTree a) where
  xs == ys = hTreeToList xs == hTreeToList ys
```

两次遍历都线性且（元素互异时）有序，故列表相等即可判定集合相等：**O(n)**（配惰性逐对比较实际为 O(min)）。

**良行为讨论。**

- `member x` **良行为**：它只看元素*集合*（结果取决于成员关系而非形状）——$xs \equiv ys$ 蕴含相同的查找结论。
- `insert x` **良行为**：向相等的集合插入得到相等的集合（平衡可能不同，但 `==` 无视形状）。
- 另外的良行为函数：`hTreeToList`（按构造）、`size`——任何经元素集合分解的函数。
- **非良行为**：`getRoot :: HTree a -> Maybe a`（返回根值）——上图中两树集相等但根分别是 2 与 4；同理 `height` 或任何暴露形状的函数。
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
**Eq 實例。** 比較*中序遍歷*（它忘掉形狀）：

```haskell
hTreeToList :: HTree a -> [a]
hTreeToList rt = go rt []
  where
    go HTip ks             = ks
    go (HNode _ lt p gt) ks = go lt (p : go gt ks)

instance Eq a => Eq (HTree a) where
  xs == ys = hTreeToList xs == hTreeToList ys
```

兩次遍歷都線性且（元素互異時）有序，故列表相等即可判定集合相等：**O(n)**（配惰性逐對比較實際爲 O(min)）。

**良行爲討論。**

- `member x` **良行爲**：它只看元素*集合*（結果取決於成員關係而非形狀）——$xs \equiv ys$ 蘊含相同的查找結論。
- `insert x` **良行爲**：向相等的集合插入得到相等的集合（平衡可能不同，但 `==` 無視形狀）。
- 另外的良行爲函數：`hTreeToList`（按構造）、`size`——任何經元素集合分解的函數。
- **非良行爲**：`getRoot :: HTree a -> Maybe a`（返回根值）——上圖中兩樹集相等但根分別是 2 與 4；同理 `height` 或任何暴露形狀的函數。

Question.en:
Define a linear-time function `invariants :: Ord a => RBTree a -> Bool` which tests that the following invariants hold on an `RBTree`:

1. It is an ordered binary search tree with no duplicates.
2. Every red node has a black parent.
3. There are the same number of black nodes on any path from root to tip.

```haskell
data Colour = R | B deriving Eq
data RBTree a
    = RBTip
    | RBNode Colour (RBTree a) a (RBTree a)
```
Question.zh-Hans:
定义线性时间函数 `invariants :: Ord a => RBTree a -> Bool`，检验 `RBTree` 上下列不变式：

1. 是无重复元素的有序二叉搜索树。
2. 每个红节点的父节点是黑色。
3. 任何根到 tip 的路径上黑节点数相同。

```haskell
data Colour = R | B deriving Eq
data RBTree a
    = RBTip
    | RBNode Colour (RBTree a) a (RBTree a)
```
Question.zh-Hant:
定義線性時間函數 `invariants :: Ord a => RBTree a -> Bool`，檢驗 `RBTree` 上下列不變式：

1. 是無重複元素的有序二叉搜索樹。
2. 每個紅節點的父節點是黑色。
3. 任何根到 tip 的路徑上黑節點數相同。

```haskell
data Colour = R | B deriving Eq
data RBTree a
    = RBTip
    | RBNode Colour (RBTree a) a (RBTree a)
```

Markscheme.en:
**Colours in one pass** — return `Just` the black height if the subtree is valid, `Nothing` otherwise:

```haskell
colourInvar :: RBTree a -> Bool
colourInvar rt = colour rt == B && isJust (go rt)
  where
    go :: RBTree a -> Maybe Int
    go RBTip = Just 1                        -- the tip counts as black
    go (RBNode R xs ys) = do
      guard (colour xs == B);  guard (colour ys == B)
      x <- go xs;  y <- go ys
      guard (x == y)
      pure x
    go (RBNode B xs ys) = do
      x <- go xs;  y <- go ys
      guard (x == y)
      pure (x + 1)
    colour RBTip          = B
    colour (RBNode c _ _ _) = c
```

  (Invariant 2 is guarded by checking both children are black at each red node; invariant 3 by requiring equal black heights from both children and threading the count upwards. The root must be black.)

**Order in one pass** — either via a strictly-increasing check on the flattening:

```haskell
strictlyIncreasing :: Ord a => [a] -> Bool
strictlyIncreasing (x1:x2:xs) = x1 < x2 && strictlyIncreasing (x2:xs)
strictlyIncreasing _         = True

orderInvar = strictlyIncreasing . rbTreetoList
  where
    rbTreetoList rt = go rt []
      where go RBTip ks = ks
            go (RBNode lt p gt) ks = go lt (p : go gt ks)
```

  …or in a single fused pass (Foldable-style) carrying the extremes out:

```haskell
orderInvar :: Ord a => RBTree a -> Bool
orderInvar = isJust . go
  where
    go RBTip = Just Nothing                       -- (min, max) seen
    go (RBNode lt x gt) = do
      lt' <- go lt;  gt' <- go gt
      guard (maybe True ((< x) . snd) lt')   -- left max < x
      guard (maybe True ((x <) . fst) gt')   -- x < right min
      pure (Just (maybe x fst lt', maybe x snd gt'))

invariants rt = orderInvar rt && colourInvar rt
```

Each pass visits every node once with O(1) work: **linear**.
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
**颜色一遍过**——子树合法则返回 `Just` 黑高度，否则 `Nothing`：

```haskell
colourInvar :: RBTree a -> Bool
colourInvar rt = colour rt == B && isJust (go rt)
  where
    go :: RBTree a -> Maybe Int
    go RBTip = Just 1                        -- tip 计为黑色
    go (RBNode R xs ys) = do
      guard (colour xs == B);  guard (colour ys == B)
      x <- go xs;  y <- go ys
      guard (x == y)
      pure x
    go (RBNode B xs ys) = do
      x <- go xs;  y <- go ys
      guard (x == y)
      pure (x + 1)
    colour RBTip          = B
    colour (RBNode c _ _ _) = c
```

  （不变式 2 由每个红节点处检查两子皆黑保证；不变式 3 由要求两侧黑高度相等并向上传递计数保证。根必须黑。）

**序一遍过**——要么对展平序列查严格递增：

```haskell
strictlyIncreasing :: Ord a => [a] -> Bool
strictlyIncreasing (x1:x2:xs) = x1 < x2 && strictlyIncreasing (x2:xs)
strictlyIncreasing _         = True

orderInvar = strictlyIncreasing . rbTreetoList
  where
    rbTreetoList rt = go rt []
      where go RBTip ks = ks
            go (RBNode lt p gt) ks = go lt (p : go gt ks)
```

  ……要么单趟融合（Foldable 风格）携带极值外出：

```haskell
orderInvar :: Ord a => RBTree a -> Bool
orderInvar = isJust . go
  where
    go RBTip = Just Nothing                       -- 见过的 (min, max)
    go (RBNode lt x gt) = do
      lt' <- go lt;  gt' <- go gt
      guard (maybe True ((< x) . snd) lt')   -- 左 max < x
      guard (maybe True ((x <) . fst) gt')   -- x < 右 min
      pure (Just (maybe x fst lt', maybe x snd gt'))

invariants rt = orderInvar rt && colourInvar rt
```

每趟每节点恰访问一次、O(1) 工作：**线性**。
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
**顏色一遍過**——子樹合法則返回 `Just` 黑高度，否則 `Nothing`：

```haskell
colourInvar :: RBTree a -> Bool
colourInvar rt = colour rt == B && isJust (go rt)
  where
    go :: RBTree a -> Maybe Int
    go RBTip = Just 1                        -- tip 計爲黑色
    go (RBNode R xs ys) = do
      guard (colour xs == B);  guard (colour ys == B)
      x <- go xs;  y <- go ys
      guard (x == y)
      pure x
    go (RBNode B xs ys) = do
      x <- go xs;  y <- go ys
      guard (x == y)
      pure (x + 1)
    colour RBTip          = B
    colour (RBNode c _ _ _) = c
```

  （不變式 2 由每個紅節點處檢查兩子皆黑保證；不變式 3 由要求兩側黑高度相等並向上傳遞計數保證。根必須黑。）

**序一遍過**——要麼對展平序列查嚴格遞增：

```haskell
strictlyIncreasing :: Ord a => [a] -> Bool
strictlyIncreasing (x1:x2:xs) = x1 < x2 && strictlyIncreasing (x2:xs)
strictlyIncreasing _         = True

orderInvar = strictlyIncreasing . rbTreetoList
  where
    rbTreetoList rt = go rt []
      where go RBTip ks = ks
            go (RBNode lt p gt) ks = go lt (p : go gt ks)
```

  ……要麼單趟融合（Foldable 風格）攜帶極值外出：

```haskell
orderInvar :: Ord a => RBTree a -> Bool
orderInvar = isJust . go
  where
    go RBTip = Just Nothing                       -- 見過的 (min, max)
    go (RBNode lt x gt) = do
      lt' <- go lt;  gt' <- go gt
      guard (maybe True ((< x) . snd) lt')   -- 左 max < x
      guard (maybe True ((x <) . fst) gt')   -- x < 右 min
      pure (Just (maybe x fst lt', maybe x snd gt'))

invariants rt = orderInvar rt && colourInvar rt
```

每趟每節點恰訪問一次、O(1) 工作：**線性**。

en: Return the black height from each subtree (Maybe Int) so equal-height checks happen on the way up.
The red-parent invariant is checked locally: at a red node, both children must be black.
For order, carry (min, max) of each subtree outwards instead of materialising lists.
zh-Hans: 从每棵子树返回黑高度（Maybe Int），等高检查就在回程完成。
红父不变式就地检查：红节点处两子必须皆黑。
查序时把每棵子树的 (min, max) 向外携带，不必物化列表。
zh-Hant: 從每棵子樹返回黑高度（Maybe Int），等高檢查就在回程完成。
紅父不變式就地檢查：紅節點處兩子必須皆黑。
查序時把每棵子樹的 (min, max) 向外攜帶，不必物化列表。

Question.en:
Prove that for a set of integers, each paired with a priority

$$S = \{(x_i, p_i) \mid 1 \le i \le n\}$$

where $x_i, p_i :: Int$, if $x_i \ne x_j$ and $p_i \ne p_j$ for any $i \ne j$, then there is a unique `t :: Treap Int` such that `t` satisfies the invariant of treaps and `nodes t` contains the same set of elements as `S`, where:

```haskell
data Treap a = Empty | Node (Treap a) a Int (Treap a)

nodes :: Treap a -> [(a, Int)]
nodes Empty              = []
nodes (Node lt x p rt) = (x, p) : nodes lt ++ nodes rt
```

Argue that as a consequence inserting the elements $\{(x_i, p_i)\}$ into a treap in different orders gives rise to the same treap, assuming all elements and priorities are distinct.
Question.zh-Hans:
证明：对整数集（每个配一个优先级）

$$S = \{(x_i, p_i) \mid 1 \le i \le n\}$$

（$x_i, p_i :: Int$），若对任意 $i \ne j$ 有 $x_i \ne x_j$ 且 $p_i \ne p_j$，则存在唯一的 `t :: Treap Int`，满足 treap 不变式且 `nodes t` 与 `S` 含相同元素集，其中：

```haskell
data Treap a = Empty | Node (Treap a) a Int (Treap a)

nodes :: Treap a -> [(a, Int)]
nodes Empty              = []
nodes (Node lt x p rt) = (x, p) : nodes lt ++ nodes rt
```

并论证：因此以不同顺序把 $\{(x_i, p_i)\}$ 插入 treap 会得到同一棵 treap（假定全部元素与优先级互异）。
Question.zh-Hant:
證明：對整數集（每個配一個優先級）

$$S = \{(x_i, p_i) \mid 1 \le i \le n\}$$

（$x_i, p_i :: Int$），若對任意 $i \ne j$ 有 $x_i \ne x_j$ 且 $p_i \ne p_j$，則存在唯一的 `t :: Treap Int`，滿足 treap 不變式且 `nodes t` 與 `S` 含相同元素集，其中：

```haskell
data Treap a = Empty | Node (Treap a) a Int (Treap a)

nodes :: Treap a -> [(a, Int)]
nodes Empty              = []
nodes (Node lt x p rt) = (x, p) : nodes lt ++ nodes rt
```

並論證：因此以不同順序把 $\{(x_i, p_i)\}$ 插入 treap 會得到同一棵 treap（假定全部元素與優先級互異）。

Markscheme.en:
Induction on $n = |S|$.

- **n = 0**: the unique treap is `Empty`.
- **n > 0**: let `t` be any valid treap with `nodes t = S`. By the heap invariant on priorities, the root has the *highest* priority in `S`; priorities are distinct, so the root is uniquely determined: it is $(x_r, p_r)$ with $p_r = \min_i p_i$. By the BST invariant on keys, the left subtree must contain exactly

  $S_l = \{(x_i, p_i) \mid x_i < x_r\}$

  and the right subtree exactly $S_r = \{(x_i, p_i) \mid x_i > x_r\}$ — keys are distinct, so this partition is forced. Both are strictly smaller than `S`, so by the inductive hypothesis each admits a *unique* valid treap. Hence `t` is `Node t_l x_r p_r t_r` with both children forced: **unique**. ∎

**Consequence.** Repeated insertion builds a valid treap whose node set is `S`; by uniqueness that treap is *the* treap of `S` — regardless of the order in which the elements were inserted. (This is also why random priorities give a *random shape* independent of the insertion order: the shape is a function of the priority assignment alone.)
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
对 $n = |S|$ 归纳。

- **n = 0**：唯一的 treap 是 `Empty`。
- **n > 0**：设 `t` 是任一满足 `nodes t = S` 的合法 treap。由优先级上的堆不变式，根拥有 `S` 中*最高*优先级；优先级互异，故根唯一确定：即 $p_r = \min_i p_i$ 的 $(x_r, p_r)$。由键上的 BST 不变式，左子树必须恰含

  $S_l = \{(x_i, p_i) \mid x_i < x_r\}$

  右子树恰含 $S_r = \{(x_i, p_i) \mid x_i > x_r\}$——键互异，此划分是被逼定的。两者都严格小于 `S`，由归纳假设各自存在*唯一*的合法 treap。故 `t` 必为 `Node t_l x_r p_r t_r` 且两个孩子都被逼定：**唯一**。∎

**推论。** 反复插入会构建出节点集为 `S` 的合法 treap；由唯一性，该 treap 就是 `S` *的* treap——与插入顺序无关。（这也解释了为何随机优先级给出与插入顺序无关的*随机形状*：形状只是优先级分配的函数。）
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
對 $n = |S|$ 歸納。

- **n = 0**：唯一的 treap 是 `Empty`。
- **n > 0**：設 `t` 是任一滿足 `nodes t = S` 的合法 treap。由優先級上的堆不變式，根擁有 `S` 中*最高*優先級；優先級互異，故根唯一確定：即 $p_r = \min_i p_i$ 的 $(x_r, p_r)$。由鍵上的 BST 不變式，左子樹必須恰含

  $S_l = \{(x_i, p_i) \mid x_i < x_r\}$

  右子樹恰含 $S_r = \{(x_i, p_i) \mid x_i > x_r\}$——鍵互異，此劃分是被逼定的。兩者都嚴格小於 `S`，由歸納假設各自存在*唯一*的合法 treap。故 `t` 必爲 `Node t_l x_r p_r t_r` 且兩個孩子都被逼定：**唯一**。∎

**推論。** 反覆插入會構建出節點集爲 `S` 的合法 treap；由唯一性，該 treap 就是 `S` *的* treap——與插入順序無關。（這也解釋了爲何隨機優先級給出與插入順序無關的*隨機形狀*：形狀只是優先級分配的函數。）

BST 不变式接着逼定哪些元素去左、哪些去右——剩余集合的一个划分。

Question.en:
Implement a `split :: Ord a => Treap a -> a -> (Treap a, Treap a)` such that `split t x` computes `(lt, rt)` where:

```haskell
nodes lt = [ (y, q) | (y, q) <- nodes t, y < x ]
nodes rt = [ (y, q) | (y, q) <- nodes t, y >= x ]
```

It should run in O(depth t) time.

Then implement insertion and deletion for treaps using only `merge` and `split`:

```haskell
insert' :: Ord a => a -> Int -> Treap a -> Treap a
delete' :: Ord a => a -> a -> Treap a -> Treap a
```

such that `delete' x y t` removes all elements in interval $[x, y)$ from `t`. In this exercise, we allow duplicate elements in a treap. (`merge` is given from Exercise 6.5.)
Question.zh-Hans:
实现 `split :: Ord a => Treap a -> a -> (Treap a, Treap a)`：`split t x` 算出 `(lt, rt)`，满足：

```haskell
nodes lt = [ (y, q) | (y, q) <- nodes t, y < x ]
nodes rt = [ (y, q) | (y, q) <- nodes t, y >= x ]
```

须 O(depth t) 时间。

再仅用 `merge` 与 `split` 实现 treap 的插入与删除：

```haskell
insert' :: Ord a => a -> Int -> Treap a -> Treap a
delete' :: Ord a => a -> a -> Treap a -> Treap a
```

`delete' x y t` 移除 `t` 中区间 $[x, y)$ 内的全部元素。本练习允许 treap 中有重复元素。（`merge` 取自练习 6.5。）
Question.zh-Hant:
實現 `split :: Ord a => Treap a -> a -> (Treap a, Treap a)`：`split t x` 算出 `(lt, rt)`，滿足：

```haskell
nodes lt = [ (y, q) | (y, q) <- nodes t, y < x ]
nodes rt = [ (y, q) | (y, q) <- nodes t, y >= x ]
```

須 O(depth t) 時間。

再僅用 `merge` 與 `split` 實現 treap 的插入與刪除：

```haskell
insert' :: Ord a => a -> Int -> Treap a -> Treap a
delete' :: Ord a => a -> a -> Treap a -> Treap a
```

`delete' x y t` 移除 `t` 中區間 $[x, y)$ 內的全部元素。本練習允許 treap 中有重複元素。（`merge` 取自練習 6.5。）

Markscheme.en:
**split** — recurse by the root key, rebuilding with the untouched side:

```haskell
split :: Ord a => Treap a -> a -> (Treap a, Treap a)
split Empty _ = (Empty, Empty)
split (Node lt y p rt) x
  | y < x     = let (rlt, rrt) = split rt x in (Node lt y p rlt, rrt)
  | otherwise = let (llt, lrt) = split lt x in (llt, Node lrt y p rt)
```

One recursive call per level, O(1) per level: $O(depth\ t)$. (`merge` is the right inverse: `uncurry merge (split t x) = t`.)

**insert' / delete'** — one split plus merges:

```haskell
insert' :: Ord a => a -> Int -> Treap a -> Treap a
insert' x p t = merge lt (merge (Node Empty x p Empty) rt)
  where (lt, rt) = split t x

delete' :: Ord a => a -> a -> Treap a -> Treap a
delete' x y t = merge lt rrt
  where
    (lt,  rt)  = split t x     -- lt: keys < x
    (rlt, rrt) = split rt y     -- rrt: keys >= y; rlt is the [x, y) part
```

(For `insert'` with duplicates allowed, the element lands between the `< x` and `≥ x` parts; for `delete'` the middle piece is simply dropped.) Both are two splits plus at most two merges: $O(depth\ t)$.
Markscheme.zh-Hans:
**split**——按根键递归、用未动的一侧重建：

```haskell
split :: Ord a => Treap a -> a -> (Treap a, Treap a)
split Empty _ = (Empty, Empty)
split (Node lt y p rt) x
  | y < x     = let (rlt, rrt) = split rt x in (Node lt y p rlt, rrt)
  | otherwise = let (llt, lrt) = split lt x in (llt, Node lrt y p rt)
```

每层一次递归、O(1) 工作：$O(depth\ t)$。（`merge` 是其右逆：`uncurry merge (split t x) = t`。）

**insert' / delete'**——一次 split 加 merge：

```haskell
insert' :: Ord a => a -> Int -> Treap a -> Treap a
insert' x p t = merge lt (merge (Node Empty x p Empty) rt)
  where (lt, rt) = split t x

delete' :: Ord a => a -> a -> Treap a -> Treap a
delete' x y t = merge lt rrt
  where
    (lt,  rt)  = split t x     -- lt：键 < x
    (rlt, rrt) = split rt y     -- rrt：键 >= y；rlt 即 [x, y) 部分
```

（允许重复时，`insert'` 把元素放在 `< x` 部分与 `≥ x` 部分之间；`delete'` 直接丢弃中段。）两者都是至多两次 split 加两次 merge：$O(depth\ t)$。
Markscheme.zh-Hant:
**split**——按根鍵遞歸、用未動的一側重建：

```haskell
split :: Ord a => Treap a -> a -> (Treap a, Treap a)
split Empty _ = (Empty, Empty)
split (Node lt y p rt) x
  | y < x     = let (rlt, rrt) = split rt x in (Node lt y p rlt, rrt)
  | otherwise = let (llt, lrt) = split lt x in (llt, Node lrt y p rt)
```

每層一次遞歸、O(1) 工作：$O(depth\ t)$。（`merge` 是其右逆：`uncurry merge (split t x) = t`。）

**insert' / delete'**——一次 split 加 merge：

```haskell
insert' :: Ord a => a -> Int -> Treap a -> Treap a
insert' x p t = merge lt (merge (Node Empty x p Empty) rt)
  where (lt, rt) = split t x

delete' :: Ord a => a -> a -> Treap a -> Treap a
delete' x y t = merge lt rrt
  where
    (lt,  rt)  = split t x     -- lt：鍵 < x
    (rlt, rrt) = split rt y     -- rrt：鍵 >= y；rlt 即 [x, y) 部分
```

（允許重複時，`insert'` 把元素放在 `< x` 部分與 `≥ x` 部分之間；`delete'` 直接丟棄中段。）兩者都是至多兩次 split 加兩次 merge：$O(depth\ t)$。
